jd_text:
Position Summary
Research and Insights: Strategy and Operations – Senior Analyst
The Senior Analyst– Research & Insights (R&I) Strategy & Operations role plays a critical execution and enablement role across strategy, operations, analytics, and delivery within Research & Insights. The Strategy & Operations (S&O) team operates across four core pillars—R&I Transformation & Strategy, Business Intelligence & Impact, Audience Growth & Activation, and Delivery Excellence. This role will address elements of each, largely in support of our Global Deloitte Insights (DI) organization.
The role will support our Global Deloitte Insights and Research and insights team with project management, thought leadership activation, stakeholder engagement, transformation initiatives, and reporting and operational support on projects. The candidate will work closely with senior leaders in Global DI and Research and Insights group to build and work on projects that have a direct impact on business priorities and strategy. A candidate with experience in working with senior executives across project management, process optimization, operations management, and reporting, will be preferred.
Work you'll do
As a Research and Insights: Strategy and Operations – Senior Analyst on the Strategy & Operations (S&O) team, you will be responsible for…
Support leadership in executing strategic priorities, business objectives, and transformation initiatives.
Plan, coordinate, and manage projects and operational initiatives, including scope, timelines, dependencies, governance activities, stakeholder communications, and deliverables.
Analyze and synthesize data; define, track, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics; and develop dashboards, pipeline reports, impact reports, and performance scorecards.
Identify and implement automation for reporting and operational processes using Microsoft Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Power Automate, and selected generative artificial intelligence (AI) platforms.
Develop presentations, reports, newsletters, and communications; maintain thought-leadership platforms and content repositories; and support knowledge sharing, process improvement, and cross-functional delivery.
The team
The Strategy & Operations (S&O) team sits within Research & Insights (R&I) team. We operate across four core pillars—R&I Transformation & Strategy, Business Intelligence & Impact, Audience Growth & Activation, and Delivery Excellence, driving R&I strategic direction.
Location: Hyderabad
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
Qualifications
Required:
Master’s degree
3+ years of experience in strategy, operations, analytics, reporting, or program management
Preferred:
Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree
Experience managing projects or operational initiatives, including scope, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
Experience using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to develop analyses, reports, or presentations
Experience using Microsoft Power BI or Tableau to develop dashboards, performance reports, or scorecards
Experience using Microsoft Power Query or Microsoft Power Automate to automate reporting or operational processes
Experience maintaining SharePoint sites, content repositories, or collaboration platforms

jd_text:
Connect to your Industry
Are you passionate about activating transformation and delivering business outcomes?
Do you look for opportunities to help businesses realise the benefits of implementing new technology by enabling people to use them well.
Do you want to work in an organisation that is leading the move to Future of Work?
If so, Deloitte’s Organisation Workforce transformation practice (part of the wider Human Capital offering) is currently recruiting for exceptional talent, who are experienced change management for technology implementation and feel their industry and technical skills could help us grow, develop our capabilities and better serve society.
You will have the opportunity to work across a range of client projects, building your skills and experience on the job, drawing on our market leading methods, global assets and tools supported by our world class professional development approach.
Having a positive social impact is at the heart of what we do. We are looking for people who share these values, as well as a passion for positive change.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunity
As a Consultant – Manager in our AI Fuelled Tech Platform Change Management team, you will play a key role in helping our clients deliver successful, technology-enabled transformation. You will:
- Lead and deliver change management workstreams within large-scale transformation programmes, such as Oracle, SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday.
- Use data, analytics, and AI tools to generate actionable insights, inform decision-making, and measure the effectiveness of change interventions.
- Collaborate with clients to design and implement strategies that drive adoption, engagement, and behaviour change.
- Work with diverse stakeholders across Deloitte and client organisations, building trusted relationships and delivering measurable impact.
- Support business development through proposal writing and client presentations.
- As we move into a world of always-on change, you will also have the opportunity to help us innovate our latest methodologies and tools, and to incubate and scale these approaches across.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
We are looking for individuals who:
- Bring genuine enthusiasm for technology, AI, and data, and thrive on helping clients unlock the full value of their technology investments.
- See the rapid pace of technological disruption, including AI and agentic capabilities, as an opportunity, not a threat and are energised by working in this dynamic, fast-evolving environment.
- Are passionate about continuous learning and personal growth, always seeking to expand their knowledge and adapt to new challenges.
- Have experience delivering change management in technology-enabled transformation programmes, ideally using data and AI to inform and measure change.
- Possess strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and translate findings into practical actions.
- Are familiar with agile methodologies and digital transformation best practices.
- Thrive in fast-paced, multidisciplinary teams and can manage multiple priorities.
- Demonstrate excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
- Bring an innovative mindset and a passion for leveraging technology to drive transformation.
- Have experience in consulting or internal change roles within the private sector.
Desirable:
- Technology platform certifications, such as Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, or Workday.
- Experience with, or certifications from, major cloud hyperscalers, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
- Experience with digital adoption platforms, analytics tools, or AI solutions.
Connect to your business - Technology and Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Human Capital
People are what powers enterprise. That’s why we need to focus on the human experience in an ever-changing, digital world. We help clients utilise technology to support their workforce, organisation, and HR Transformations.

jd_text:
Connect to your Industry
Are you passionate about leading business transformation for complex and high-profile programmes? Do you get excited about working with a diverse mix of teams and in different organisational contexts?
Organisation and Workforce Transformation – Training Solutions
Our OWT Solution business sits as part of Organisation and Workforce Transformation within our Human Capital practice – the world’s leading people and HR transformation business. As part of a practice that brings leading-edge tooling, research and analytics expertise together with deep industry knowledge, you’ll help to deliver innovative and complex transformation programmes for our clients.
Training and Learning Centre of Excellence
The continued success of our Training and Learning Centre of Excellence (CoE) team means that we are looking to grow further by recruiting specialists with experience in delivering Training and Learning services across all industries with the right skill set and attitude towards performance, growth and development. We partner with clients to deliver critical people, behavioural, and culture change essential for successful business transformations. Our expertise spans the entire transformation lifecycle, from strategic assessment and planning to comprehensive delivery support.
You will have the opportunity to work with one or many elite clients in:
- Consumer
- Technology, Media and Telecoms
- Energy, Resources and Industrials
- Healthcare and Life Sciences
- Government and Public Services
- Financial Services
As part of a practice that brings leading-edge tooling, research, analysis, automation and AI expertise together with deep industry knowledge, you’ll develop transformation programmes that are not only innovative but deliver the most positive impact for all.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunity
This team is focused on the technical delivery of new solutions that solve complex challenges for clients. Join us to drive innovation and technology forward, collaborating with cross-functional teams and using cutting-edge tools. Offering excellent development opportunities, you will have the chance to hone your technical craft, gain new skills, and complete qualifications and certificates. This is your chance to make a real impact.
You will have responsibility for:
- Help clients to realise the benefits of implementing new technology by enabling a great employee learning experience and allowing people to adopt new ways of working quickly and successfully; this could involve but is not limited to:
- Training and Learning content design and development
- Training needs analysis
- Learning planning and logistics
- Training delivery
- Collaborate with a range of stakeholders both internally within Deloitte and in client organisations, building trusted relationships and contributing to project success;
- Support practice development by contributing to new initiatives and proposals to build the capability of the team;
- Supporting the development of our solutions and methods;
- Mentoring and managing less experienced members of the team.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
To qualify for the role, you must have experience of:
- Experience of design and development of training content;
- Previous experience of supporting training delivery on projects or programmes, either within industry or with a consultancy;
- Development of training plans and managing dependencies;
- Proficiency with digital tools for content creation (e.g., Adobe, Vyond, Synthesia);
- Understanding and experience of project management methodologies (example Prince 2 or Agile);
- An innovative mindset with a keen interest in new thinking around transformation, change management, and learning technology disruptors (e.g., Gen AI, Digital Adoption Platforms)
- Knowledge of the current market conditions;
- Excellent communication, problem solving and analytical skills.
Additional desirable experience includes:
- Development of appropriate solutions, methods and tools;
- Prince 2 Foundation and Practitioner Certified;
- SC (Security Check) Clearance

Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.

jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
People & Organisation w PwC Polska tworzy 20 specjalistów. Pomagamy klientom PwC w każdym wyzwaniu związanym z zarządzaniem najbardziej wrażliwym kapitałem przedsiębiorstw - ludźmi, którzy je tworzą. Zajmujemy się szerokim zakresem usług od zagadnień formalnych, przez wdrażanie transformacji organizacyjnej, po zarządzanie zespołami i tworzenie przyjaznego i stymulującego miejsca pracy. Pracujemy z klientami z Polski i zagranicy; wspieramy też zespoły PwC w Polsce i za granicą.
Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:
HR Transformation Consultant
Twoja przyszła rola:
-
udział w projektach transformacji funkcji HR oraz transformacji organizacyjnych realizowanych dla klientów z różnych branż,
-
wspieranie klientów w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu docelowych modeli operacyjnych HR (HR Target Operating Model),
-
analizowanie procesów HR end-to-end, struktur organizacyjnych oraz sposobów funkcjonowania organizacji w celu identyfikacji obszarów wymagających zmian,
-
ocena wpływu planowanych zmian na pracowników, liderów i organizację oraz opracowywanie rekomendacji wspierających skuteczne przeprowadzenie transformacji,
-
projektowanie i realizacja działań z zakresu change management, obejmujących m.in. zarządzanie interesariuszami, komunikację transformacyjną oraz budowanie adopcji zmiany,
-
prowadzenie warsztatów, sesji roboczych oraz spotkań z klientami i kluczowymi interesariuszami,
-
opracowywanie analiz, prezentacji oraz materiałów dla kadry zarządzającej wspierających podejmowanie decyzji transformacyjnych,
-
współpraca z liderami biznesowymi, zespołami HR oraz ekspertami technologicznymi przy wdrażaniu nowych procesów i rozwiązań HR,
-
wspieranie rozwoju oferty i budowanie eksperckiej wiedzy zespołu w obszarze transformacji HR i zarządzania zmianą.
Aplikuj, jeśli:
-
masz minimum 4 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w jednym z obszarów: HR Transformation, Organizational Change Management, HR Business Partneringu, Organizational Design, Workforce Transformation lub HR Consulting,
-
uczestniczysz w projektach obejmujących transformację funkcji HR, zmianę modelu operacyjnego, reorganizację struktur organizacyjnych lub wdrażanie nowych procesów i technologii HR,
-
znasz zagadnienia związane z change managementem, komunikacją transformacyjną oraz zarządzaniem adopcją zmiany,
-
rozumiesz funkcjonowanie nowoczesnych organizacji HR, w tym role HR Business Partnerów, Centrów Kompetencyjnych (CoE) oraz Shared Services,
-
masz doświadczenie w prowadzeniu warsztatów i współpracy z klientami oraz kadrą zarządzającą,
-
bardzo dobrze komunikujesz się w języku angielskim (minimum C1),
-
wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
-
cechujesz się samodzielnością oraz umiejętnością budowania relacji.
Mile widziane:
-
doświadczenie zdobyte w firmie konsultingowej,
-
udział we wdrożeniach systemów HR, takich jak Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM lub podobnych rozwiązań,
-
certyfikacje z obszaru change management lub project management.
Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:
-
elastyczne warunki - hybrydowy model pracy (min. 2 dni pracy z biura w tygodniu), elastyczny początek dnia, workation, sabbatical leave,
-
rozwój i podnoszenie kwalifikacji - pełne wsparcie zespołu podczas procesu wdrożenia, mentoring, szkolenia, warsztaty, certyfikacja współ-/finansowana przez PwC oraz konwersacje z native speaker,
-
szeroki program medyczno-wellbeingowy - pakiet opieki medycznej (m.in. opieka stomatologiczna, swoboda leczenia, fizjoterapia), coaching, sesje mindfulness, wsparcie psychologiczne, edukacja poprzez dedykowane webinary i warsztaty, doradztwo finansowo-prawne,
-
możliwość stworzenia indywidualnego planu benefitowego (wybór m.in. lunch pass, pakiet ubezpieczenia, concierge, pakiet weterynaryjny dla pupila czy masaże) oraz dostęp do kafeterii - w środku m.in. vouchery, zniżki na urządzenia IT i zakup samochodu,
-
3 godziny płatnego urlopu w miesiącu na wolontariat,
-
dodatkowy dzień wolnego z okazji urodzin,
-
a kiedy polubisz to miejsce tak, jak my, możesz polecić znajomych do PwC.
Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?
-
​uzupełnij formularz oraz prześlij CV,​
-
​​porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterem,​
-
​​poznajmy się lepiej na rozmowie rekrutacyjnej!​
W razie problemów, napisz do nas: pl_kariera@pwc.com. Uprzejmie informujemy, że mail nie służy do wysyłania CV.
Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w celu przeprowadzenia rekrutacji jest PwC Advisory sp. z o.o. sp.k., lub inna spółka z sieci PwC (lista spółek), do której kierujesz aplikację. Management Level

Job Description & Summary
Kia ora,
Be a catalyst for transformation. Shape the future at PwC New Zealand.
At PwC, our purpose is clear: to build trust in society and solve important problems.
This is a place to keep growing. You’ll learn from the best, take on meaningful challenges, and make a lasting impact for our clients, our communities, and Aotearoa.
Ngā kōrero mo tēnei tūranga / About the role
Due to growth, we’re looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Finance and Operations Transformation team in Tāmaki Makaurau / Auckland.
In this role, you’ll focus on procurement and supply chain transformation engagements. Our team supports private and public sector clients across procurement strategy, operating model design, strategic sourcing, category management, supplier performance, cost optimisation and broader operations transformation.
Your day-to-day could include:
-
Working with clients on strategic procurement, supply chain and cost transformation programmes, helping shape and deliver initiatives that create lasting commercial and operational impact.
-
Tackling complex business and supply chain challenges, using data, structured problem solving and market insights to identify opportunities and develop practical solutions.
-
Developing new strategies and approaches across areas such as procurement, supply chain, operating models, cost optimisation and broader business transformation.
-
Turning analysis into clear insights, recommendations and compelling stories that support senior leaders to make informed decisions.
-
Working alongside client teams to translate strategy into action, supporting the design, implementation and delivery of transformation initiatives.
-
Building trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, collaborating across organisations to solve problems and drive change.
-
Contributing to the growth of our practice by bringing new ideas, developing proposals and helping shape solutions for current and future clients.
Ngā pūkenga ka kawea mai e koe, ka whakawhanakehia rānei i tēnei tūranga / Skills you will bring or develop in this role
-
Around 3–5 years’ experience in consulting, procurement, supply chain, operations, commercial or another relevant business environment.
-
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex or ambiguous problems and turn information into meaningful insights.
-
Experience contributing to projects, transformation programmes or initiatives focused on improving business performance, reducing cost or delivering better outcomes.
-
Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how organisations operate, how markets and suppliers work, and where opportunities for improvement exist.
-
Strong communication skills, with the ability to develop clear recommendations and communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders.
-
Confidence building relationships and working collaboratively with clients, colleagues and senior stakeholders.
-
An adaptable and proactive mindset, with the ability to learn quickly, take ownership and work across different clients, industries and challenges.
-
Curiosity about emerging technology, data and A.I., and how these can be used to transform the way organisations operate.
Ngā āhuatanga hirahira o te mahi ki PwC / Highlights of working at PwC NZ
Rewards - Discretionary bonus opportunities; generous referral bonuses; retail discounts & deals
Growth - Global network; leadership development; A.I. tools and training; formal learning pathways
Wellbeing - $250 annual wellbeing allowance; Life & income protection; Sonder/EAP/Headspace; 15 days’ paid sick leave; group-rate health insurance (eligibility applies)
Reputation - PwC is known for shaping tomorrow. Join us and you’ll accelerate your career while helping clients and communities solve their most important problems.
Flexibility - Flexible working; supportive coaching culture
Time off - Two paid recognition days off provided each year during our annual summer shutdown period; purchase up to two extra weeks’ annual leave
Whānau & community - Paid parental leave for all parents with flexible options and financial planning support; inclusive networks; paid volunteering leave
Mō te aha tāu e tatari ana? / What are you waiting for?
Hit Apply now. To learn how you can grow and shine in your career at PwC, visit our careers site at https://www.pwc.co.nz/careers.html.
Grow here. Go further.

Motuhake / Independence: Maintaining independence is fundamental to demonstrating that PwC has not been influenced by any relationships or situations that undermine our objectivity. This role requires an independence review process.
Tono tika mai / Please apply directly: We’re not currently partnering with recruitment agencies for this role. If you’d like to be considered, please apply directly - we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our Workforce Transformation Consulting team supports organizations in their organizational transformation initiatives. Our professionals accompany clients throughout their transformation journeys, including aligning operating models with business strategy, upskilling talent and human resources, improving employee engagement, and managing change. As a Senior Associate, Workforce Transformation, you will play a key role un delivering end-to-end transformation projects, leveraging your expertise and understanding of management concepts.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Associate, Workforce Transformation (Bilingual FR/ENG), unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:
- Working with PwC teams and client teams on client engagements, from strategy through implementation.

- Contributing to the development of your own technical skills and those of your team at the local, national, and global levels within our network.
- Staying current on developments in your areas of expertise and in the industries served, and contributing to the development of PwC’s knowledge and points of view.
- Continuing to build strong internal relationships and strengthening one’s positioning within PwC.

- Strong interest in skills development in a digital environment and in technological trends, with an openness to learning new tools and adopting new ways of working.

Agimos com integridade

jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Kā vecākais konsultants Tu piedalīsies stratēģiski svarīgu projektu īstenošanā sadarbībā ar Latvijas publiskās pārvaldes iestādēm, pašvaldībām, kapitālsabiedrībām un Eiropas Savienības institūcijām. Kopā ar projekta komandu Tu izstrādāsi stratēģijas, novērtēsi organizāciju un procesu efektivitāti, kā arī ieviesīsi pārmaiņas.​
Ko Tu darīsi?​
- Piedalīsies konsultāciju projektu īstenošanā un/vai patstāvīgi vadīsi projekta komandu 2-5 cilvēku sastāvā. ​
- Konsultāciju projekta ietvaros būs jāveic:​
- informācijas izpēte, apkopošana, datu analīze un vizualizēšana; ​
- intervijas, anketēšana, procesu kartēšana un koprades darbnīcas;​
- ziņojuma gatavošana.​
- Gatavosi piedāvājumus publiskā sektora un starptautisko organizāciju klientiem;​
- Veidosi un uzturēsi attiecības ar esošajiem un jaunajiem klientiem.​ ​​​
Par Tevi:​
- Obligāta pieredze pieredze konsultāciju jomā - analītiska darba veikšanā, t.sk. informācijas izpētē, datu analīzē un pētījumu ziņojumu sagatavošanā;
- Vēlama pieredze projektu vadībā, stratēģiju, procedūru aprakstu izstrādē.​
- Augstākā izglītība; ​
- Ļoti labas latviešu un angļu valodas prasmes, kas ir nepieciešamas veiksmīgai darbībai starptautiskā vidē, saziņai un sadarbībai ar ārvalstu kolēģiem un klientiem;​
- Proaktivitāte un orientācija uz rezultātu; ​
- Motivācija tiekties uz profesionālu izaugsmi un iegūt jaunas zināšanas.​
​
Ko Tu iegūsi, pievienojoties PwC Latvija komandai?​
- Atbalstoša, draudzīga un uz sadarbību vērsta komanda;​
- Iespēja sadarbībā ar starptautiskām institūcijām strādāt pie Latvijai stratēģiski nozīmīgiem projektiem;​
- Ikgadēja atalgojuma pārskatīšana, bonusu programma, papildus ikgadējā atvaļinājuma dienas un prombūtnes dienas nozīmīgos dzīves notikumos; ​
- Individuāli radīts attīstības plāns Tavai profesionālajai izaugsmei un pieredzējis mentors Tev līdzās;​
- Iespēja attīstīt savas profesionālās prasmes caur dažādiem semināriem vietējā un starptautiskā mērogā, kā arī caur e-apmācībām;​
- Apmaksāts sertifikācijas process (PRINCE2, PMP, CFA, u.c.);​
- Pievilcīgs labumu grozs pēc pārbaudes laika beigām (veselības apdrošināšana, 3. pensiju līmenis, budžets ēdināšanas vai sporta/veselības pakalpojumiem);​
- Iespēja strādāt arī attālināti (hibrīda modelī);​
- Regulāras komandas saliedēšanās aktivitātes un labbūtības iniciatīvas;​
- Atalgojums no 1900 līdz 3000 EUR (bruto) mēnesī atkarībā no kandidātam piemītošajām kompetencēm.​ ​

Knowledge of (pre-)clinical regulations as well as quality and risk management.

title: Data Management Consultant (Junior / Senior)
summary: Pomůžeš nám řešit praktické problémy s daty napříč projekty.
Budeš komunikovat s technickými i byznysovými stakeholdery a sbírat jejich požadavky.
Budeš definovat a automatizovat pravidla pro kvalitu dat a podílet se na jejich technické implementaci.
education: Zapojíš se do oblastí Data Governance, Metadata Management, Master Data Management a AI Governance.
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Baví tě práce s daty nejen na strategické, ale i na praktické úrovni? Rozumíš datovým modelům a chceš umět ověřit a nastavit kvalitu dat tak, aby fungovala v reálném provozu, nejen na papíře? Chceš se nebát zapojit do jakéhokoliv datového projektu – ať jde o nastavení pravidel kvality dat, návrh datových struktur nebo řešení konkrétního technického problému? A zároveň umíš svoje řešení srozumitelně vysvětlit klientovi i týmu? Pak se připoj k naší rostoucí praxi v oblasti Data Management a Governace v týmu Data & AI společnosti PwC.
Jaký bude tvůj tým
Jako člen týmu pro Data Management a Governance se budeš podílet na řešení konkrétních technických i procesních výzev v oblasti dat. Zaměříš se především na kvalitu dat a práci s datovými modely, navrhneš, jak ověřit a udržet data správná, konzistentní a bez duplicit, a pomůžeš to i technicky zrealizovat. Vedle toho se dostaneš i k širšímu záběru řízení dat, jako je Data Governance, Data Lifecycle Management, Master Data Management, Metadata Management nebo AI Governance. Budeš spolupracovat s odborníky z Data & AI týmu a podílet se na projektech pro přední společnosti napříč trhem.
Na koho se můžeš spolehnout
Tamás Kuczik je manažer pro oblast řízení dat. Vystudoval Data a IT na VŠE v Praze, kde propojil svět dat, technologií a byznysu, a tomuto spojení zůstává věrný i dnes. Před nástupem do PwC pracoval na straně dodavatele platformy pro Data Governance, díky čemuž dobře rozumí technologiím a nástrojům používaným v oblasti řízení dat. Věří, že řešení musí přinášet reálnou hodnotu a nezůstat pouze na papíře.
Ve volném čase je aktivní jak sportovně (běh, turistika, cyklistika, posilovna), tak kulturně, rád zajde do kina, divadla nebo na koncert.
O čem bude tvoje role
- Pomůžeš nám řešit praktické problémy s daty napříč projekty.
- Budeš komunikovat s technickými i byznysovými stakeholdery a sbírat jejich požadavky.
- Budeš definovat a automatizovat pravidla pro kvalitu dat a podílet se na jejich technické implementaci.
- Zapojíš se do analýzy datových modelů a databází.
- Budeš sledovat a mapovat tok dat mezi systémy (data lineage) a navrhneš, jak data v organizaci efektivně strukturovat a řídit.
- Vyzkoušíš si práci s různými nástroji pro správu a zpracování dat, API a automatizací.
- Zapojíš se do oblastí Data Governance, Metadata Management, Master Data Management a AI Governance.
- Získáš zkušenosti s regulatorními tématy, jako jsou GDPR, EU AI Act a Data Act.
Tohle je pro nás důležité
- Zájem o praktickou práci s daty, od analýzy a modelování po nastavení a ověřování jejich kvality.
- Základní znalost principů Data Governance (např. role, odpovědnosti, standardy pro práci s daty).
- Znalost alespoň jednoho programovacího nebo skriptovacího jazyka, orientace v databázích a datových modelech.
- Vynikající komunikační a prezentační dovednosti.
- Silné analytické myšlení, proaktivní přístup a plynulá znalost angličtiny a češtiny/slovenštiny.
A tohle ti dá náskok
- Zkušenost s cloudovými platformami (Azure, AWS, GCP), API nebo automatizací procesů (ETL, BI nástroji).
- Praktická zkušenost s některou z oblastí správy a řízení dat (např. Data Quality, Master Data Management, Metadata Management).
- Zkušenost s big data platformami nebo nástroji pro streamování dat (např. Kafka, Spark, Databricks).
- Znalost frameworků DAMA nebo DCAM a zkušenost s jejich zaváděním do praxe.
- Znalost oblasti informačních systémů, enterprise architektury nebo umělé inteligence.
Čím tě potěšíme my
- Rozvoj, který odpovídá tvým ambicím a tempu. Možnost získat během krátké doby zkušenosti, které jinde sbíráš roky.
- Férovou mzdu bez rozdílů. Patříme mezi několik málo firem v ČR s Equal Pay Certifikací.
- Flexibilní benefitní program s 30 000 body, který si nastavíš podle vlastních priorit.
- 30 dní placeného volna, ve kterých jsou zahrnuty tři dny well-being a dva dny volna na konci roku.
- Příležitost vrátit něco zpět společnosti – jeden dobrovolnický den ročně na nás.
- Možnost vyzkoušet si práci v některé ze zahraničních kanceláří PwC (od úrovně Senior Associate)
- Podporu tvého rozvoje a vzdělávání: Školení a certifikace v oblasti business a digitálních dovedností odpovídající tvému zaměření, rozvoj soft skills včetně prezentování, koučinku a efektivní komunikace a další. Hradíme technické certifikace.
- Buddy systém a pravidelná zpětná vazba na tvoji práci, také konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.
- Širokou podporu well-beingu a zdravého životního stylu – od programů Dr. Digital a Human Dynamic až po např. jógu na pracovišti a běžecké závody.
- Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.
- Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days
V PwC pomáháme klientům řešit současné i budoucí výzvy napříč oblastmi auditu, poradenství, daní, práva, technologií a dat. Vytváříme prostředí, ve kterém se lidé mohou učit, růst a budovat kariéru podle svých představ. Věříme, že nejlepší výsledky vznikají díky různorodým zkušenostem a pohledům. Proto budujeme inkluzivní kulturu, ve které má každý možnost být sám sebou, využít své silné stránky a přispívat k práci, která má skutečný dopad.
Zaujala tě naše nabídka? Dej nám o sobě vědět a probereme spolu další podrobnosti!

Il ruolo è inserito nel team Capital Projects & Infrastructure di PwC Business Services. La figura ricercata lavorerà su progetti complessi nei settori Infrastrutture, Trasporti e Logistica, supportando lo sviluppo di piani strategici, piani industriali e attività di pianificazione dei trasporti, con un know-how tecnico-settoriale (funzionamento delle reti e dei servizi di trasporto, materiale rotabile, standard operativi) a supporto delle analisi economico-finanziarie. jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
PwC Poland’s Data, Digital Solutions & AI team comprises more than 50 specialists. We help our clients design and implement a strategic and sustainable approach to capitalising on the value of their data and boosting business results. We collaborate with organisations in various industries to develop solutions tailored to their needs.
We are looking for:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant
You will support Polish and international clients in designing and delivering enterprise‑grade MDM and data governance solutions that generate measurable business value. You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders to define target operating models, master data processes, governance structures and implement technologies.
Your future role:
- Support client consultations and workshops, translating business and IT objectives into MDM / MDG strategies, target operating models, functional requirements and transformation roadmaps,
- Design and formalize master data management frameworks, including roles (Data Owners, Data Stewards), RACI models, policies, standards and operating principles,
- Elicit, prioritize and document requirements; map existing and define adjusted end‑to‑end master data processes (creation, change, approval, distribution, retirement) across master data domains,
- Define and validate master data models, hierarchies and attributes in close collaboration with business stakeholders,
- Design and operationalize data quality management frameworks, including validation rules, KPIs, monitoring, reporting, issue management and escalation paths,
- Assess clients’ current data and system landscapes, identify inefficiencies and design pragmatic transformation paths, including modern governance concepts (e.g. data mesh),
- Prepare and deliver executive‑level presentations, demos and pre‑sales sessions; clearly articulate recommendations to senior and C‑level stakeholders.
Apply, if you have:
- 2+ years of professional experience in MDM field, ideally in a consulting or client‑facing role,
- Proven experience designing and implementing MDM domains (e.g. Product/Material, Supplier, Customer, Reference Data),
- Demonstrated expertise in MDM governance and operating model design, including organizational enablement and processes and roles definition,
- Understanding of master data modeling, validation rules, data quality management and the full master data lifecycle,
- Hands‑on experience with at least one enterprise MDM platform (e.g. SAP MDG, Stibo, Informatica, Ataccama),
- Ability to independently lead workshops, facilitate discussions and align business and IT stakeholders,
- Excellent communication skills in Polish and English (C1+), including executive storytelling and structured thinking,
- Have demonstrated knowledge of new technologies and AI‑powered tools in your daily work (e.g., task automation, information analysis, content creation),
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to work autonomously and take accountability for outcomes.
Nice to have:
- End‑to‑end MDM / MDG implementation experience (operating model, domains, processes, tool selection, integrations),
- Hands-on experience with SAP ERP and SAP MDG,
- Professional communication skills in German, enabling participation in workshops, interviews and presentations with German‑speaking clients,
- Experience designing data strategies and operating models for modern data platforms (e.g. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake) and understanding their governance implications,
- Understanding of Data Management and Data Governance Frameworks.
By joining us you gain:
- work flexibility - openness for your preferences regarding contract form, hybrid working model, flexible start of the day, workation, sabbatical leave and additional summer solutions (e.g. Slow Fridays),
- development and upskilling - our full support during onboarding process, mentoring from experienced colleagues, training sessions, workshops, certification co/financed by PwC and conversations with native speaker,
- wide medical and wellbeing program - medical care package (incl. dental care, freedom of treatment, physiotherapy), various insurance packages (incl. foreign travel insurance), coaching, psychological consultations, concierge for young parents, sports groups and more,
- possibility to create your individual benefits package (e.g. personal concierge, veterinary packages for your pets, financial & legal assistance) and access to an online cafeteria where you may find i.a. vouchers, discounts for IT devices and car purchase,
- 3 paid hours for volunteering per month,
- and when you start enjoying PwC as much as we do, you may recommend your friend to work with us.

Send your application today!

At A.F.Ferguson & Co, our vision is to be the first choice employer for professional staff. As a trusted business advisor, we work in a changing world which offers great opportunities for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We seek to attract and employ the best people from the widest talent pool, as well as those who reflect the diverse nature of our society. And we aim to encourage a culture where people can be themselves and be valued for their strengths. A career in our Management Consulting practice, within General Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help clients seize essential advantages by working alongside business leaders to solve their toughest problems and capture their greatest opportunities. We work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever changing environment. We help create sustainable change by stimulating innovation, unlocking data possibilities, navigating risk and regulatory complexity, optimising deals, and aligning costs with business strategy to create a competitive advantage.
As a member of our team, you’ll help the world’s most significant organisations, public and private, quickly become more effective. We improve the way they operate; manage costs; better align people, process and technology initiatives; support business growth to maintain or improve competitive edge; and complete market and regulatory risk assessments. jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
PwC, jako światowego lidera w obszarze usług chmurowych, wspiera zespół Cloud & Digital PwC Polska. Świadczymy najwyższej jakości usługi we wszystkich obszarach związanych z chmurą, takich jak: Cloud Strategy, Cloud Migrations, Cloud Efficiency / FinOps, Data Analytics, DevOps, Application Modernization & Cloud Native. Wspieramy największe rynkowe firmy w procesie wprowadzania innowacji, wdrażania owych technologii, w tworzeniu nowych modeli biznesowych oraz usprawnianiu działań operacyjnych.
Jesteśmy liderem doradztwa technologicznego w Polsce. Doradzamy największym firmom w Polsce i zagranicą jak wykorzystać nowe technologie do transformacji ich firm. Dołączenie do naszego zespołu będzie dla Ciebie oznaczać pracę nad szerokim spektrum projektów wzdłuż całego łańcucha wartości - od strategii transformacji, przez implementację technologii, zmiany organizacyjne, usprawnienia operacyjne i efektywnościowe w obszarze technologii. Na co dzień, będziesz pracować we wszystkich branżach oraz w oparciu o różnorodne technologie, przede wszystkim chmurowe a także w środowiskach hybrydowych i on-premise. Będziesz korzystać ze wsparcia innych lokalnych zespołów oraz z globalnej sieci PwC. Dołączając do naszego zespołu, stajesz się częścią organizacji o głębokiej kulturze współpracy i ciągłej nauki. Naszym priorytetem jest wspieranie Twojego rozwoju w roli lidera, by wspólnie tworzyć pozytywne i długotrwałe zmiany.
Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:
Senior IT Strategy and Operations Consultant
Twoja przyszła rola:
- współpraca z najwyższym kierownictwem firm oraz liderami IT przy definiowaniu strategii IT, zgodnej ze strategią biznesową i celami organizacji,
- projektowanie i wdrażanie docelowych modeli operacyjnych IT, obejmujących strukturę organizacyjną, role i odpowiedzialności, procesy, governance, sourcing oraz modele współpracy z biznesem,
- wsparcie klientów w projektowaniu i transformacji Cloud Operating Models, modeli hybrydowych oraz sposobów dostarczania usług IT,
- prowadzenie analiz obecnego modelu działania IT, identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień oraz przygotowywanie konkretnych rekomendacji,
- udział w projektach digital transformation, IT transformation, operating model transformation i organizacyjnej transformacji funkcji IT,
- analiza i usprawnianie procesów IT delivery, zarządzania usługami, portfelem projektów, dostawcami, popytem oraz zmianą,
- wsparcie klientów w definiowaniu modeli zarządzania, KPI, SLA, mechanizmów raportowania oraz zasad podejmowania decyzji,
- planowanie i prowadzenie warsztatów z klientami, moderowanie dyskusji oraz budowanie porozumienia pomiędzy biznesem, IT i innymi interesariuszami,
- przygotowywanie przejrzystych i angażujących prezentacji PowerPoint, zarządowych podsumowań, materiałów warsztatowych oraz rekomendacji,

- posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu modeli operacyjnych IT oraz modeli organizacyjnych, procesowych i zarządczych,
- znasz zagadnienia związane z digital transformation, IT transformation, IT service delivery oraz zarządzaniem zmianą,

- potrafisz analizować złożone problemy, formułować hipotezy oraz przekładać je na jasne, praktyczne rekomendacje,
- tworzysz bardzo dobre, przejrzyste i angażujące prezentacje PowerPoint, również dla zarządów i najwyższej kadry kierowniczej,
- posiadasz bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne – potrafisz jasno przekazywać złożone koncepcje biznesowe, technologiczne i organizacyjne,
- masz doświadczenie w prowadzeniu warsztatów, prezentowaniu rekomendacji oraz pracy z interesariuszami na różnych poziomach organizacji,
- posiadasz silne umiejętności interpersonalne, negocjacyjne i organizacyjne,
- wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
- potrafisz komunikować się ustnie i pisemnie w języku polskim i angielskim,
- łatwo adaptujesz się do zmian i pracy projektowej, typowych dla branży konsultingowej.
Mile widziane:
- doświadczenie w projektach związanych z tworzeniem strategii IT, Target Operating Model, IT Operating Model lub Cloud Operating Model,
- znajomość frameworków i metodyk, takich jak ITIL, COBIT, SIAM, Agile, SAFe, DevOps, PRINCE2, PMP lub Scrum,
- doświadczenie w projektowaniu modeli sourcingowych, vendor management, service integration oraz governance IT,

- umiejętność pracy z danymi, dashboardami i narzędziami analitycznymi, np. Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, SQL lub Excel,
- doświadczenie w pracy z zespołami międzynarodowymi i globalnymi modelami dostarczania usług.
Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:

- rozwój i podnoszenie kwalifikacji - pełne wsparcie zespołu podczas procesu wdrożenia, mentoring, szkolenia, warsztaty, certyfikacja współ-/finansowana przez PwC,

title: Senior Finance Transformation Consultant
summary: Budeš součástí projektů zaměřených na transformaci financí a zvyšování efektivity finančních procesů.
Pomůžeš klientům s implementací AI agentů, EPM/CPM a DMS systémů.
Budeš analyzovat a mapovat business požadavky a navrhovat vhodná řešení.
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Jaký bude tvůj tým
Consulting v oblasti finanční transformace v PwC není jen o tom být součástí velké firmy. Jde především o to vidět, jak věci funguj v různých společnostech. Obvykle jsme přímo v centru dění a pracujeme v projektových týmech přímo u klienta. Neustále rozvíjíme své dovednosti, a to nejen prostřednictvím projektů pro klienty, ale také díky dalším zajímavým aktivitám.
Věnujeme se projektům zavádění sofistikovaných řešení pro finanční konsolidaci, pomáháme klientům správně nastavit fungování financí a krátkodobě jim vypomáháme překlenout období, kdy hledají stálé zaměstnance do controllingu a konsolidačního týmu. Zabýváme se také řešením komplexních transformací finančního oddělení a analýzou velkých datových celků.
Na koho se můžeš spolehnout
Jiří Schwarz má 10 let profesionálních zkušeností v oblastech účetnictví, controllingu, datové analýzy a auditu. Zkušenosti získal prací na projektech finanční transformace a také při přípravě konsolidovaných finančních výkazů pro lokální i nadnárodní klienty. Zaměřuje se na širokou agendu CFO a transformaci finančních oddělení do moderní podoby. 3 roky působil v PwC Nový Zéland v Aucklandu, kde získal profesionální mezinárodní zkušenosti a široké znalosti IFRS. Nyní se těší na nové členy týmu, kteří s ním budou sdílet nadšení pro finance a inovace, a dohromady vytvoříte silný tým, který posune projekty na novou úroveň.
O čem bude tvoje role
- Budeš součástí projektů zaměřených na transformaci financí a zvyšování efektivity finančních procesů.
- Pomůžeš klientům s implementací AI agentů, EPM/CPM a DMS systémů.
- Budeš analyzovat a mapovat business požadavky a navrhovat vhodná řešení.
- Zapojíš se do návrhu cílových procesů a jejich optimalizace.
- Budeš spolupracovat na implementaci navržených řešení přímo u klientů.
- Využiješ moderní technologie včetně AI, Power BI, Alteryx a dalších nástrojů.
- Podpoříš klienty při digitalizaci a automatizaci finančních procesů.
- Budeš spolupracovat s multidisciplinárními týmy v Česku i zahraničí.
- Pomůžeš klientům zvládat změny spojené s růstem, reorganizací nebo akvizicemi.
- Získáš možnost podílet se na projektech napříč různými sektory a zeměmi.
Tohle je pro nás důležité
- VŠ vzdělání ekonomického zaměření.
- Znalost češtiny na úrovni rodilého mluvčího a plynulá znalost angličtiny.
- 5–7 let zkušeností v controllingu nebo FP&A ve středně velké či velké společnosti.
A tohle ti dá náskok
- Zkušenosti s tvorbou controllingových a manažerských reportů a finančních analýz.
- Dobrá znalost procesů finančního oddělení.
- Plynulá znalost němčiny.
- Znalost EPM nástrojů, například Tagetik, Jedox, OneStream nebo obdobných řešení.
- Zkušenosti s implementačními projekty.
- Zájem o digitalizaci, automatizaci a využití AI ve financích.
Čím tě potěšíme my
- Rozvoj, který odpovídá tvým ambicím a tempu. Možnost získat během krátké doby zkušenosti, které jinde sbíráš roky.
- Férovou mzdu bez rozdílů. Patříme mezi několik málo firem v ČR s Equal Pay Certifikací.
- Flexibilní benefitní program s 45 000 body, který si nastavíš podle vlastních priorit.
- 30 dní placeného volna, ve kterých jsou zahrnuty tři dny well-being a dva dny volna na konci roku.
- Příležitost vrátit něco zpět společnosti – jeden dobrovolnický den ročně na nás.
- Možnost vyzkoušet si práci v některé ze zahraničních kanceláří PwC (od úrovně Senior Associate)
- Podporu tvého rozvoje a vzdělávání: Interní vzdělávací programy podporované PwC Academy včetně rozsáhlého úvodního školení. Nastavení tvé vzdělávací dráhy v průběhu tvého kariérního růstu, včetně profesních certifikátů (CFA, FRM, ACCA, CIMA, CAA apod.), našich kurzů Digital Upskilling Academy a mnoha dalších.
- Buddy systém a pravidelná zpětná vazba na tvoji práci, také konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.
- Širokou podporu well-beingu a zdravého životního stylu – od programů Dr. Digital a Human Dynamic až po např. jógu na pracovišti a běžecké závody.
- Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.
- Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days.
V PwC pomáháme klientům řešit současné i budoucí výzvy napříč oblastmi auditu, poradenství, daní, práva, technologií a dat. Vytváříme prostředí, ve kterém se lidé mohou učit, růst a budovat kariéru podle svých představ. Věříme, že nejlepší výsledky vznikají díky různorodým zkušenostem a pohledům. Proto budujeme inkluzivní kulturu, ve které má každý možnost být sám sebou, využít své silné stránky a přispívat k práci, která má skutečný dopad.
Zaujala tě naše nabídka? Dej nám o sobě vědět a probereme spolu další podrobnosti!

jd_text:

PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement.
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences.
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble.
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Vous serez amené(e) à collaborer au quotidien avec nos différentes plateformes et practices, afin d’adresser des problématiques complexes de manière intégrée.
Description du poste & résumé
Au sein de l’équipe Cloud Transformation de PwC France, vous apportez votre expertise dans la conduite de projet de transformation métier avec le potentiel offert par les technologies Cloud. Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la définition de stratégie et de leur feuille de route de transformation pour répondre à leur nouveaux enjeux métier et dans la mise en œuvre de projets de transformation avec des solutions innovantes. Le cloud est au cœur des transformations de nos clients et apportent de nouvelles opportunités. Votre intervention couvrira notre approche de bout-en-bout, de l’idée à la création de valeur. Vous participerez à l’élaboration de feuille de route de transformation métiers, d’analyse de marché et de sélection de solutions, de définition d’architecture fonctionnelle de bout-en-bout, d’expérimentation et de pilotage de programme pour répondre aux enjeux de nos clients grands comptes.

Job Description & Summary:
PwC's Advisory practice works with the world's leading global custodians, asset servicers, and asset managers to implement front-to-back investment management and order management platforms. This Business Analyst role focuses on the capital markets domain – covering front-office trading, order management, compliance, derivatives, and trade lifecycle through to settlement.
We are looking for individuals with experience working within or alongside Global Capability Centers (GCCs) of major financial institutions – particularly those that have supported OMS/EMS implementations, trading operations, derivatives processing, or front-office technology programs.

Front Office / Order Management Domain:
- Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements for order management system (OMS) implementations covering order generation, execution, allocation, compliance, and portfolio management
- Define requirements for workflow design – new account/sleeve setup, automated global order routing by asset class and region, new debt issuance workflows (shell security setup, interest solicitation alerts, portfolio manager order sizing, security enrichment, trade execution)

- Support FIX onboarding and integration requirements – leveraging understanding of FIX protocol for broker connectivity and electronic trading
Trade Lifecycle & Settlement:
- Document end-to-end trade lifecycle requirements from order generation through settlement – covering equities, fixed income, FX, derivatives (OTC & listed), and complex instruments
- Define requirements for settlement-matching logic, enriched data mapping for triparty integrations, and exception tagging aligned with institutional settlement models
- Support requirements for T+1 settlement readiness and related platform transformation initiatives
Integration & Operating Model Design:
- Define data integration requirements between front-office OMS and downstream middle/back-office systems (accounting, reconciliation, data platforms)
- Document interface specifications for system-to-system integrations across the front-to-back chain
- Support Future State Operating Model (FSOM) design and documentation for front-office service transitions
- Develop Service Level Documentation defining service scope, KPIs, SLAs, and operational processes
Derivatives & Complex Instruments:
- Analyze requirements for OTC derivatives processing – collateral, margin, and settlement workflows
- Document requirements for bank loan processing, structured credit instruments, and complex instrument handling
- Support requirements for UMR compliance – initial margin, variation margin, SIMM calculations

Job Description & Summary
PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement.
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences.
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble.
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Nous aidons nos clients, les grands établissements du secteur financier, en leur offrant une vision innovante de la gestion des risques, des solutions adaptées aux enjeux (macroéconomiques, IA, cybersécurité, durabilité, etc.), ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue pour renforcer leur résilience et soutenir leur croissance, en intégrant le risque dans leur stratégie et leurs décisions.
Nous combinons diverses compétences en comptabilité, réglementation bancaire, gestion des risques et audit interne pour aider nos clients à maîtriser leurs risques. Notre équipe crée, perfectionne et valide les dispositifs de gestion des risques en s'appuyant sur les meilleures technologies et pratiques du secteur. Rejoindre cette activité, c'est renforcer la protection et la résilience des organisations dans un monde en constante évolution.
Vos missions
Au sein de l'équipe Risk & Finance vous intervenez au sein de grands établissements bancaires dans un rôle de conseil auprès des directions financière et des équipes reporting des banques sur l’ensemble des problématiques de reporting financier, à la fois comptables et réglementaires.
Votre rôle couvre un périmètre large, combinant expertise technique, projets de transformation et de sécurisation des processus :
-
Projets de transformation (organisation, processus, outils) et de sécurisation des processus de reporting financier au sein des établissements financiers
-
Accompagnement stratégique des clients sur leurs problématiques techniques liées au reporting financier, comptable et/ou prudentiel
-
Aider à la résolution de sujets techniques liés à des opérations complexes et/ou exceptionnelles (transactions M&A, évolutions normatives, opérations spécifiques, exigences réglementaires)
-
Optimisation des impacts financiers dans la structuration d'opérations capitalistiques ou de nouveaux produits et activités
-
Mise en œuvre de plans de remédiation dans des contextes de crise liés au reporting financiers (fraude, erreur, situation de crises...)
-
Missions de conseil en lien avec la communication financière de nos clients et la remontée d'informations aux organes de gouvernance
Votre profil
-
Diplômé·e d’un Master en comptabilité, finance ou audit
-
Expérience de 3 à 6 ans auprès d'une Direction Financière et/ou d'un cabinet d'audit/conseil
-
Une expérience en audit externe de clients bancaires constitue un atout fort pour ce poste
-
Maîtrise des fondamentaux comptables ; une exposition aux sujets prudentiels/réglementaires est appréciée
-
Fort esprit d’équipe, aisance relationnelle, rigueur, curiosité pour la technologie et la réglementation
-
Maîtrise du Pack Office (PPT, Excel)
-
Niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2/C1)

Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain
-

This position is for an Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.

S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).

Unser Strategy& Energy, Utilities & Resources (EUR) Deals Team begleitet führende Unternehmen und Investoren bei strategischen Fragestellungen und Transaktionen rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Als Senior Associate (w/m/d) im Bereich Energy und Deals spielst du eine wesentliche Rolle bei der Beratung führender Unternehmen und Investoren rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Established in the region for 40 years, PwC has around 12,000 people in 12 countries across the region: Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, the Palestinian territories, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
Our regional team operates across the Middle East bringing international experience delivered within the context of the region and its culture. We can bring the collective knowledge and experience of more than 370,000 people across the entire global PwC network in advisory, assurance and tax to help you find the value you are looking for.
About Us
With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
Line of Service Overview
Business Enablement Solutions (BES) brings together the specialist functions that enable PwC Middle East to operate, grow and deliver on its strategic ambitions.
Our teams span People and Talent, Finance, Technology and AI, Risk and Quality, Business Development, Communications and Brand, Leadership Support, Operations, Transformation and Workplace Services. Together, we enable our people to do their best work, strengthen how our business operates and support our client-facing teams to deliver for our clients.
As a human-led, tech-powered organisation, we’re using data, technology and AI to simplify how we work, drive innovation and support the continued growth and transformation of PwC Middle East. A career in BES gives you the opportunity to be part of that change.Enabling growth. Delivering excellence.
Business Unit Overview
AI Strategy & Technology at PwC Middle East combines strategic foresight with digital innovation to accelerate transformation. We shape operating models, design technology roadmaps, and deliver integrated solutions that drive growth and resilience. By exploring emerging technologies, advancing intelligent automation, and leveraging data-driven insights, we unite strategy, design, and execution—helping PwC and its clients harness innovation, navigate disruption, and achieve sustainable outcomes.
How You’ll Contribute
As a Senior Associate – AI Workforce Transformation (Adoption), you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Own the adoption strategy for firm-wide AI tools and agents across PwC Middle East, setting the direction, priorities, and targets that move staff from aware to actively using AI in their daily work, and closing the gap between licences held and value realised.
Own the measurement and value framework for AI adoption: define the KPIs, build and maintain the dashboards (Power BI and platform analytics), and turn usage and engagement data into the decisions on where to focus adoption effort next.
Own the ROI and value-realisation story, running the surveys, time-and-value studies, and benefit analysis needed to evidence impact, and presenting the results and investment recommendations to senior leadership, including ExCo.
Provide senior leadership of the AI champions network — shaping its strategy, curating the playbooks and enablement assets it runs on, and steering where champions focus — working alongside the wider team who deliver day-to-day activity.
Design the firm's adoption interventions and enablement approach — onboarding journeys, use-case clinics, and targeted campaigns — prioritising the teams, licences, and capabilities where usage is lagging and directing effort to the highest-value gaps.
Drive AI to become embedded in everyday ways of working, partnering with line-of-service and team leads to integrate tools into rituals, templates, and processes so that usage becomes the default and is sustained beyond initial launch.
Translate adoption and value insight into compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations for leadership, and inform licence optimisation and future investment decisions.
What You’ll Bring
Years of experience:
4+ years of relevant experience in AI/digital adoption, enablement, transformation, or benefits/value realisation, ideally within professional services or a large enterprise environment, including experience owning an initiative end to end.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. A relevant Master's degree is an advantage.
Designations & Certifications:
Data analytics or BI certifications (e.g. Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate) are highly desirable.
Change management certification (e.g. Prosci / ADKAR) is an advantage.
Technical Skills:
Strong data and measurement capability: hands-on building and interpreting dashboards and adoption metrics in Power BI and advanced Excel, defining KPIs and ROI models; familiarity with SQL is an advantage.
Strong working knowledge of GenAI tools and the AI adoption landscape, including how usage, behaviour change, and value are measured for AI initiatives.
Able to shape enablement strategy and curate high-quality assets — playbooks, prompt libraries, and campaign materials — that build capability across non-technical audiences.
Soft Skills:
Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and present with credibility to senior leadership, including ExCo audiences.
Strong analytical and storytelling skills, comfortable turning usage and value data into clear recommendations that drive decisions.
A self-directed, ownership mindset — sets direction, energises a champions network, and drives adoption where it is lagging without waiting to be asked.
Language Skills:
Fluency in English is required. Arabic language skills are an advantage.
Travel Requirements: Your flexibility to travel x% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients.
How You’ll Make a Difference
At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
Why You’ll Love Working at PwC
At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job - you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

#KGS
Consultant Pricing Strategy
About us
The position in discussion is with the Deal Advisory team at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery centre and is an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability, globally.
KGS’ Deal Advisory Group is a team of 1500+ professionals, with three offices in Gurgaon, Mumbai and Bangalore.
KGS DA has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. Leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modeling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking
About the team
The Strategy team works with C-level Executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues across the economic and transaction cycles. As part of a fast-paced and dynamic group, our consultants offer strategic advice on financial, business and operating models to corporate, public sector and private equity clients.
KGS Strategy team in India is organized by sectoral and functional capabilities to provide practical and actionable recommendations that can be delivered by the client in a cost-effective manner, both in a deal and non-deal environment. Key member firms with which KGS Strategy team works include KPMG UK and KPMG US.
About the role
Within the Strategy team we have an established Pricing strategy practice, serving number of sectors including retail, consumer goods, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial manufacturing sectors serving US, and other international clients. We work with C-level executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues related to deal strategy, and growth strategy.
KPMG’s Pricing strategy practice is a specialised team focused on solving pricing and revenue optimisation problems for its clients using data and analytics techniques to deliver a sustainable solution which can deliver both short- and long-term margin improvements. As a team, we are a group of bright committed individuals who are passionate about delivering fantastic client work, solving complex data related problems, investing our time in acquiring new analytical skills, and having fun both inside and outside of work.
Responsibilities:
We are recruiting for a consultant with Pricing / Data Analytics experience. The role is currently part of KPMG’s Pricing Strategy team based in India that works closely with KPMG US and includes following core responsibilities:
- Work collaboratively with senior onshore stakeholders and client teams, in the development and implementation of pricing strategy, solutions/ recommendations
- Support in developing proposals and enhancing sales strategies for potential clients
- Understand client system and data structures and designing and executing data intensive analysis to support development of evidence-based insights
- Managing engagement work-streams and analysis, including defining deliverables, setting timelines, and develop high quality output, taking responsibility for teams when required
- Leverage analytical tools & platforms such as Alteryx, Power BI, Python etc. to manage large data sets and drive insights
- Develop documentation and insights in PowerPoint decks
- Plan and undertake primary and secondary research to develop insightful analysis for clients
- Implementation of solutions/tools in client environment and train client to implement new approach and appropriate tools
- Contributing to thought leadership and knowledge management to support practice development
Required qualifications:
- Education/professional qualifications: MBAs/ B. tech/ B.E. from a leading Indian/International educational institution
- Extensive professional experience (minimum of 2-3 years) in strategy or analytics roles, acquired from corporate positions, analytic boutique firms, or strategic consulting firms
- Minimum of 2 years of specific experience in pricing strategy and revenue optimization, handling complex pricing problems and developing effective strategies
Required key Skills:
- Experience in business research and data analytics with strong understanding of databases and data manipulation (data cleansing, aggregation and summary)
- Experience of complex modelling and analysis by using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL, etc.
- Proven ability to identify complex pricing problems, develop innovative solutions, and implement effective pricing strategies to drive business growth and profitability
- In-depth understanding of pricing methodologies, including value-based pricing, cost-based pricing, competitive pricing, dynamic pricing, and pricing optimization
Preferred skills:
- Good to have hands-on experience in developing Python codes (using IDEs like Spyder, Jupyter, etc.) and working with python libraries Pandas, Numpy, Scipy etc.
- Experience in designing/implementing machine learning models for pricing applications including but not limited to price elasticity models, forecasting, customer segmentation, linear regression, logistic regression, random forest etc.
- Possesses strong numerical, analytical, and strategic skills, with sound commercial acumen
Responsibilities
- Conduct pricing strategy and revenue optimization analyses using large and complex datasets to identify pricing opportunities, assess market dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that enhance profitability and growth.
- Leverage analytics tools such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Power BI to perform data cleansing, modeling, forecasting, customer segmentation, and pricing optimization while translating insights into impactful client deliverables and executive presentations.
- Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to develop and implement pricing solutions, manage project workstreams, support business development initiatives, and deliver strategic recommendations for clients across diverse industries.
Qualifications
3+ years of experience in pricing, analytics or revenue strategy

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1725478
Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Senior Consultant
Location: Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote
Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Consultant with an expertise in Procurement and Sourcing to join our team at EY GDS-SC&O. This is a remarkable chance to work with a top-tier company and play a key role in expanding the range of new service offering.
The opportunity
By joining our team, you will assist clients in enhancing their supply chain efficiency. Utilizing EY GDS-SC&O's proprietary frameworks, you will help clients to improve the reliability, flexibility, and responsiveness of their supply chain while reducing the total cost. Your responsibilities will involve creating an operating model, re-engineering procurement processes, optimizing working capital, performing rapid assessments, building assets/tools, and coming up with thought leadership.
Your key responsibilities
- Deliver consulting engagements across procurement strategy, operating model design, category management, sourcing optimization, and procurement transformation.
- Collaborate with the extended teams and clients to design and implement effective supply chain transformation projects for diverse industries.
- Perform advanced spend analytics to identify value creation opportunities. Translate procurement and operational data into strategic recommendations to enhance competitiveness, reduce costs, and optimize the supply chain.
- Assess the maturity level of procurement processes and initiate improvements to the current processes and systems/technologies.
- Conduct procurement benchmarking across operating models, organization structures, processes, sourcing outcomes, and supplier rates and develop fact-based recommendations.
- Assess procurement operating models and design future-state target governance frameworks, organizational structures, capability requirements, and sourcing delivery models.
- Support strategic category management through fact-based market intelligence. Analyze supplier markets, industry trends, inflationary pressures, and cost drivers.
- Review and validate data and further build optimization models, analytical reports, dashboards and presentations.
- Support digital procurement and AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Evaluate and implement procurement technologies and automation opportunities.
- Acquire knowledge of new age procurement tools; such as Ariba, COUPA, Ivalua, SAP MM, PP etc. and work on process design/ reengineering/ implementation projects related to the process and/or tool.
Skills and attributes for success
- Experience in strategic procurement, category management (direct and/or indirect spend), procurement excellence, procurement systems
- Effective communication skills and experience in customer-facing role
- Ability to work independently and proactively
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, category management, or supply chain advisory.
- Knowledge of Procurement Methodologies: Procurement Matrix, Vendor selection and evaluation methods
- Sourcing, offer analysis and benchmarking
- Strategic approach and negotiation skills
- Understanding of legal and contractual requirements
- Expertise in end-to-end procurement process covering one or more of the following areas: spend analytics, E2E process redesign, Source to Contract, Procure to Pay, data integration, etc.
- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Entrepreneurial mindset, design thinking and passion for improvement and optimization
Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience in Data Visualization using Tableau /Power BI / QlikView etc.
- System Knowledge like Ariba, Coupa, SAP modules etc.
- Knowledge of other languages (German, French) will be an additional asset
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
