Join EY and shape your future with confidence
The opportunity
As a member of Supply Chain & Operations, you'll contribute to one of the fastest-growing consulting practices in the region. If you are looking for a cutting-edge and rewarding environment within the procurement and sourcing domain, this may be the role you've been searching for.
You will work with leading organizations to improve procurement performance, optimize sourcing strategies, strengthen supplier relationships, and transform procurement operations. Working alongside high-performing teams and senior client stakeholders, you will help clients drive sustainable value creation through procurement transformation and technology-enabled solutions.
Your key responsibilities
You will be responsible for delivering large-scale, complex procurement and supply chain transformation projects, including the design, implementation, deployment and evaluation of business solutions that improve procurement effectiveness and business performance.
You will be working with client organizations to enhance procurement capabilities through process optimization, operating model transformation and organizational redesign. You will work collaboratively with project teams to analyze client challenges, develop practical solutions and support successful implementation.
You can expect to work closely with senior client stakeholders to design, evaluate and improve procurement functions across sourcing, supplier management and source-to-pay processes.
Key responsibilities include:
- Lead and support procurement transformation engagements across various industries.
- Assess current-state procurement processes and identify improvement opportunities.
- Design and implement procurement operating models, governance structures and sourcing strategies.
- Help clients improve procurement effectiveness, efficiency and supplier performance.
- Support strategic sourcing, category management and supplier relationship management initiatives.
- Drive source-to-pay (S2P) process transformation and optimization programmes.
- Analyze client issues and develop practical, data-driven recommendations.
- Manage project workstreams, deliverables, status reporting and stakeholder communications.
- Build strong client relationships and deliver high-quality client services.
- Support business development activities including proposals, presentations and thought leadership initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
- Demonstrated technical capabilities and professional knowledge in sourcing and procurement transformation.
- Strong understanding of procurement processes, supplier management and procurement operating models.
- Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new processes and identify opportunities to enhance client value.
- Strong analytical and process-oriented problem-solving skills.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Ability to develop and present innovative ideas and practical solutions.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with client personnel.
- Ability to identify additional opportunities and support business development activities.
- Understanding of EY service offerings and the ability to assess how the firm can support client needs.
To qualify for the role you must have
- A bachelor's degree or master's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain consulting, transformation or related industry roles.
- Demonstrated experience helping organizations improve sourcing and procurement effectiveness and efficiency.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Strategic Sourcing
- Category Management
- Source-to-Pay (S2P)
- Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)
- Contract Lifecycle Management
- Procurement Operating Model Transformation
- Procurement Outsourcing
- Experience delivering transformation, process improvement or consulting projects related to procurement and sourcing functions.
Ideally, you'll also have
- Experience with technology-enabled procurement transformation and implementation initiatives.
- Experience implementing procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Zycus, Oracle Procurement Cloud, SAP S/4HANA Procurement or similar solutions.
- Experience in spend analytics, supplier performance management or procurement digital transformation initiatives.
- Experience supporting large-scale procurement transformation programmes across multiple business units or geographies.
- Relevant procurement, supply chain, project management or change management certifications.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1709716
EY est au cœur de la transformation et de la digitalisation de la fonction finance.
Les équipes Financial Accounting and Advisory Services (FAAS) d’EY accompagnent les directions financières pour répondre aux grands enjeux de la fonction finance.
Pour cela, EY propose un large éventail de services en matière de transformation de la fonction finance, de pilotage de la performance, de reporting consolidé, d’excellence comptable, de trésorerie, d’optimisation des processus financiers et de contrôle interne, et d’assistance comptable pour les transactions (acquisition, carve out, introduction en bourses, refinancement…).
Ses interventions couvrent tous les secteurs de l’économie, de l’industrie aux activités de services.
Les clients sont principalement des groupes français ou internationaux, cotés ou non.
Dans le cadre du renforcement de son offre, notre bureau de Rouen recrute des collaborateurs expérimentés pour accompagner nos clients sur les projets de transformation orientés sur la digitalisation et le pilotage de la performance.
Vos missions
Intégré à une équipe de plus de 50 collaborateurs, vous mettez en œuvre de façon opérationnelle vos savoir-faire et compétences en matière de gestion de projet et de mise en œuvre de Solutions Digitales Finance.
Vous prendrez part à des projets et missions de différentes natures autour de projet de transformation :
- Intégration de solutions de digitalisation au sein de la Direction Finance,
- Automatisation, sécurisation et fiabilisation des données comptables et processus clés de production de l’information financière,
- Mise en place de solution de type Analytics pour faciliter l’analyse de données (data vizualisation),
- Gestion de projets de mise en œuvre de solutions permettant l’automatisation des processus financiers et comptables : outils de dématérialisation du processus de clôture, outils de Robotic Process Automation (RPA), outils de Business Intelligence (BI), Outils de pilotage de la performance (EPM),
- Accompagnement dans les projets de transformation de nos clients dont une partie concerne la digitalisation (refonte stratégique du pilotage de la performance, intégration de sous-groupe acquis, convergence des systèmes et des organisations, IPO, refinancement),
- Définition des modalités d’organisation ainsi que des plans de transformation et accompagnement dans leur mise en œuvre.
Vous accompagnerez nos clients en France comme à l’étranger au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire orientée sur l’assistance aux directions financières.
Vos connaissances fonctionnelles en finance, consolidation ou reporting vous permettront de comprendre les enjeux et problématiques de nos clients et de leur proposer des solutions à haute valeur ajoutée. Vous avez l’habitude de travailler en équipe en mode projet, et avez une appétence pour les nouvelles technologies.
L'expérience accumulée au fil des missions ainsi que le programme de formation suivi permettent de progresser et d’évoluer au sein du cabinet.
Pourquoi pas vous ?
Le développement de nos collaborateurs est la clé de notre réussite : EY vous permet de personnaliser votre projet en fonction de vos appétences et développper vos compétences techniques, financières et manageriales. Formations dédiées, accès aux technologies de pointe et ressources documentaires spécialisées, mobilité interne, interventions d’experts, vous serez accompagné tout au long de votre expérience EY pour relever les défis d’aujourd’hui et de demain.
Avez-vous entendu parler du Smartworking chez EY ?
Le SmartWorking vous permet de choisir les modalités de travail les plus appropriées à la conduite de vos missions en conciliant vos envies/engagements et nos services auprès de nos clients. Vous ne vivrez plus jamais le travail comme avant.
Votre profil
- H/F, de formation supérieure Bac+5 (école de commerce, d’ingénieurs ou une université avec une spécialisation en Finance / Gestion) ;
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience (en cabinet ou en entreprise) d’au moins 2/3 ans acquise au sein d’un service Consolidation, Contrôle de gestion, Transformation Digital Finance ;
- Vous possédez de bonnes capacités techniques en consolidation, reporting ou en utilisation d’une des solutions digitales du marché (Alteryx, Blackline, UiPath, Blueprism, Qlick, Tableau, PowerBI, Board, Anaplan, Tagetik, OneStream, Group Reporting, SAP FC, SAP PBC, HFM, FCCS, PBCS, Planning Analytics, …) ;
- Vous savez travailler en mode projet et en équipe, prioriser les sujets et prendre du recul ;
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens de l’analyse et votre capacité à aborder des sujets complexes, vos qualités d'adaptation, de rigueur et de proactivité ;
- Vous avez une grande aisance de la communication orale et écrite et un bon sens de la formalisation ;
- Vous avez une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais écrit et oral.
Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description ? Alors nous souhaitons vraiment vous rencontrer.
À propos d’EY
EY rassemble aujourd’hui plus de 300 000 associés et collaborateurs à travers le monde dans plus de 150 pays. Grâce à ce réseau, dont le niveau d’intégration et l’ampleur internationale sont gages d’une même excellence partout dans le monde, EY renforce sa position de leader mondial de l’Audit, du Conseil, des Transactions, de la Fiscalité et du Droit. The opportunity : Manager-National-PAS WKFA-CNS - PC - Workforce Advisory - Gurgaon
National : National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
CNS - PC - Workforce Advisory :
At EY, People Consulting professionals help clients' in strategically aligning their people agenda with broader business goals. By placing Humans at the Center of the transformation journey, we help organizations drive sustainable change through the power of their workforce. You will have the opportunity to work with global clients to understand and address some of their largest and most complex people related challenges, and ultimately improve and drive sustainable business results. Our approach enables clients to reimagine their future workforce—ensuring they have the right talent, with the right skills, in the right roles, at the right cost—ultimately turning their people strategy into a competitive advantage.
The key fields of play are:
Organization and Workforce Transformation- Integrated approach to align business and workforce strategies with current and future operating models by applying capabilities such as scenario modelling, org design, workforce planning & analytics as well as talent strategy, leveraging our proprietary, award-winning EY Organization & Talent Hub.
Change Experience & Learning - Working with clients to define the new Workforce Experience including New Ways of Working (Agile, Design Thinking, Digital, Problem Solving, Collaboration) as well as accelerated adoption through our digitally-enabled Change Experience tracked via Change Insights and Digital Learning via our EY Noggin Labs platform.
Purpose, Culture and Leadership - Align leadership and cultural programs with clients’ business strategy, purpose and operating model, adapting to the changing needs of their customers and building modern leadership and talent capabilities to drive efficiency and innovation.HR Transformation, Systems and Rewards - Re-imagining and digitizing the HR function, including HR strategy, HR service delivery model, HR cloud technology as well as transforming employee policies and rewards to align with business and individual objectives.
Your key responsibilities
- As a Manager, you will be a key resource on business transformation projects. In this role, you should be able to deliver quality client service, deliver insightful solutions and balance multiple priorities. You will also be expected to have excellent communication skills, integrate into and lead new teams, and rapidly establish relationships.
- Demonstrate technical competence in our capabilities(Leadership Development, Succession Planning, Talent management, Change management) and take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex client challenges.
- Contribute to generating profitable revenue through identifying follow-on engagement opportunities and developing lasting relationships with clientsLead project work streams from planning through to implementation - managing project resources and budgets effectively.
- Be able to influence and persuade clients and stakeholders to gain support for any major change initiatives and/or decisionsTake a practical approach to solving issues and gaining client agreementEncourage and facilitate collaboration amongst team members, and promote an inclusive working environmentIdentify and effectively manage and mitigate any risks and issues.
- Contribute to business development and client pursuit activities by preparing proposals and delivering presentations for potential clientsProvide coaching and development opportunities for junior resources and peers, and act as a visible role model for our people.
Areas of work:
Talent Transformation, Leadership Development, Total Rewards, Succession Planning, Organizational Design, Performance Management and career mapping, HR Operating & Delivery Model, HR Process Efficiency & Policy, Organizational Change Management
Technical Competency Post graduate degree or equivalent with a specialization in Human Resources (India or abroad) from a Tier 1 Institute.6 - 9 years of experience in HR Strategy and ConsultingDemonstrated expertise in applying consulting frameworks to assess and optimize workforce strategies. Strong analytical skills to interpret labor market trends and provide actionable insights for clients. Proficient in developing tailored workforce solutions that align with organizational goals and client needs. Experience in conducting workforce assessments and implementing change management practices. Ability to leverage data-driven methodologies to enhance workforce performance and efficiency.
Ideally you’ll also haveStrong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

education: You will be able to develop your leadership, consultancy and technology skills. Working on the most challenging projects, engaging with CIO / CDO / CTO and other CXO-level executives, across...
jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1735463
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
As part of our high-performing Technology Strategy & Transformation Team, you will deliver exceptional client service — consulting clients on technology strategies, providing advice on how technology enablement, digital transformation and enterprise intelligence will enable their business strategies. You will work with clients on their strategic technology solutions, and support clients transforming IT organizations, operating models and capabilities.
You will be able to develop your leadership, consultancy and technology skills. Working on the most challenging projects, engaging with CIO / CDO / CTO and other CXO-level executives, across borders and sectors.
Plus, you'll have fun while doing it, collaborating with a dynamic team that values creativity and innovation! The experiences you gain here will be more valuable than anywhere else, so, whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Your key responsibilities
- Contribute to engagement teams to realize clients’ strategy, process, people, and technology transformations
- Participate in transformational technology consulting engagements:
- Technology Strategy & Assessment
- Business/technology/solution architecture
- Business and IT Requirements definition
- IT process design
- Transformational technology program management
- Design and improvement of IT operating models
- ServiceNow and Microsoft technologies advisory
- Work effectively and independently as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication, and updating senior team members on progress
- Leverage data and technology to assist senior team members in providing innovative solutions to clients’ challenges
- Assist in preparing high quality work products for clients and other related parties in timely manner
- Anticipate and identify risks within engagements and raise any issues with senior members of the team
- Develop and maintain productive working relationships with clients’ personnel
- Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting and with other services across the organization
- Follow our educational program to continually develop personal skills and capabilities
- Contribute to people-related initiatives including recruiting and retaining consulting professionals
What we look for
- Master’s degree from a reputable University with excellent academic records
- 1-3 years for Consultant and 3-6 years for a Senior Consultant of experience in Big4 consultancies, Strategy Houses or similar department within industry organizations or niche consultancies
- Customer-centricity, strong interpersonal skills – a Team Player!
- Strong analytical thinking, problem solving skills, presentation and communication skills
- Excellent analytical skills for both business and technology solutions to enable the development of business process and/or technical solutions, including analyzing business and technology problems in a clear concise manner
- Before all, you have a keen interest in Technology. We hire for the mindset in priority, not the skill set.
- Excellent skills in both written and verbal English and German
Ideally, you’ll also have
- ITIL certification
- Project Management Certification (SCRUM, PMI, PRINCE2 etc.)
- Understanding of Technology Strategy and Transformation disciplines including IT Strategy, Digital, Infrastructure and Cloud Strategy, Service Resiliency, Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Sourcing and IT service management
- Knowledge of Enterprise Applications and technologies like ServiceNow, Microsoft (Office 365, Dynamics, Azure, etc.) AWS, Google Cloud, SAP, Oracle, Veeva, IQVIA, Salesforce, Pega
- Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends, including artificial intelligence, deep learning, advanced predictive modelling, etc.
- Exposure to programming or scripting languages: for instance, C++, Java, Python.
What’s in it for you
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need to stay relevant today and, in the future, – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1743601
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Muligheten
Vi søker erfarne konsulenter til vårt Technology, Strategy & Transformation miljø på våre kontorer i Oslo, Trondheim og Stavanger.
EY jobber med kunder som står overfor spennende og krevende valg knyttet til digitalisering, implementering av fremtidsrettet teknologi og modernisering av arbeidsprosesser. Kort sagt med å løse komplekse utfordringer i skjæringspunktet mellom strategi og teknologi. Arbeidet spenner fra strategi og analyse innen sourcing og anskaffelse til prosjektledelse og endringsarbeid i forbindelse med implementering. Vi hjelper kundene våre med å etablere retning, ta gode beslutninger og sikre at initiativer gir ønskede resultater og varig verdi.
Vi bistår hovedsakelig kunder innen offentlig sektor, infrastruktur, helse, energi, finans og retail. Hos oss får du jobbe tett med både store og små kunder i ulike industrier, og med kolleger på tvers av fagområder og lokasjoner. I EY står fagutvikling sentralt, og du vil få tett oppfølging og støtte fra dyktige kolleger som bidrar til at du stadig lærer nye ting og utvikler deg.
Dine ansvarsområder
Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig rådgivningsmiljø som hjelper virksomheter med å lykkes i grensesnittet mellom teknologi og virksomhet. Vi hjelper kundene med å oppnå verdi fra digitale transformasjoner.
Avhengig av bakgrunn og interesse vil du blant annet jobbe med:
- Strategi, digitalisering og transformasjon
- Anskaffelse av teknologi, sourcing og leverandørevalueringer
- Analyse og forbedring av teknologirelaterte prosesser og styringsmodeller
- Ledelse eller koordinering av prosjekter, programmer og teknologiimplementeringer
- Interessenthåndtering, risiko, fremdriftsstyring og gevinstrealisering
- Endringsledelse og organisasjonsutvikling
- Rådgivning til ledere og beslutningstakere i komplekse teknologiinitiativer
Ferdigheter og egenskaper for suksess
For å kvalifisere deg for rollen må du ha:
- Relevant høyere utdanning innen teknologi, økonomi, ingeniørfag eller tilsvarende
- 2-6 års relevant erfaring innen teknologi-, endrings- eller digitaliseringsinitiativer, for eksempel innen prosjektledelse, systemimplementeringer, anskaffelser, sourcing eller virksomhetsutvikling
- Erfaring som konsulent
- Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
Det er også en fordel dersom du har erfaring med å lede prosjekter, leveranser eller team. Dersom du i tillegg har jobbet med utvikling av kunderelasjoner og markedsrettet arbeid er dette positivt.
Vi tror du vil lykkes hos oss dersom du er nysgjerrig, initiativrik og strukturert, og motiveres av å løse komplekse utfordringer. Du bygger gode relasjoner, tar ansvar og skaper fremdrift sammen med kunden og teamet rundt deg.
Hva vi tilbyr deg
Hos EY utvikler vi deg med fremtidsrettede ferdigheter og gir deg erfaringer i verdensklasse. Vi gir deg mulighet til å utvikle deg i et fleksibelt miljø, med en mangfoldig og inkluderende kultur og mulighet for å jobbe på tvers av vårt globale nettverk. Les mer om hva vi tilbyr deg her.
Virker dette spennende?
Vi mottar alle søknader elektronisk via vår søknadsportal og ber deg om å laste opp:
- CV
- Søknadsbrev
Er du klar til å «Shape your future with confidence»? Søk i dag – og senest innen 25.10.2026
I EY verdsetter vi mangfold og oppmuntrer søknader fra individer fra ulike bakgrunner. Hvis du har spørsmål, trenger støtte eller tilpasning av rekrutteringsprosessen på grunn av en funksjonsnedsettelse, ikke nøl med å kontakte oss på rekruttering@no.ey.com. Vi er her for å støtte deg.
Ved spørsmål om stillingen er du velkommen til å kontakte:
Oslo – Elisabeth Wallem, Elisabeth.Wallem@no.ey.com
Trondheim – Ove Rygg, Ove.Rygg@no.ey.com // +47 971 33 869
Stavanger – Nikki Kooger, Nikki.Kooger@no.ey.com

The opportunity : Consultant-FS-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Marketing Sales & Service - Mumbai
FS :
Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
CNS - BC - Marketing Sales & Service :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen mit. Im Team Technology Strategy & Transformation entwickelst du innovative IT-Strategien und begleitest komplexe Transformationsprojekte. Wir verbinden Technologie, Business und Menschen, um nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen – von Cloud-Architekturen und FinOps bis zu agilen Operating Models. Dabei behalten wir Trends wie Künstliche Intelligenz, AI Financial Management, AI FinOps und Automatisierung im Blick. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:
- Du berätst Unternehmen bei der Steuerung, Optimierung und Transparenz ihrer IT-Kosten und entwickelst zukunftsfähige Financial-Management-Ansätze für die IT.
- Du unterstützt CIOs und IT-Organisationen dabei, den Wertbeitrag von IT, Digitalisierung, Cloud und AI messbar zu machen und fundierte Managemententscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
- Du entwickelst KPI-, Reporting- und Steuerungsmodelle für moderne IT-Organisationen und schaffst Transparenz über Kosten, Leistungen und Ergebnisse.
- Du arbeitest an strategischen Themen wie IT-Budgetplanung, Kostenkontrolle, IT Value Management sowie der finanziellen Steuerung von Transformationsprogrammen.
- Du analysierst Cloud- und AI-Kostenstrukturen, identifizierst Kostentreiber und entwickelst konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen im Umfeld von FinOps, AI Financial Management und Cost Optimization.
Dein Skillset
- Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs und bringst erste Erfahrungen im IT Financial Management, Controlling oder IT-Performance-Umfeld mit.
- Du verfügst über die für die Position erforderlichen fachlichen Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Cloud- und FinOps-Umfeld und interessierst dich für Zukunftsthemen wie AI Financial Management, AI FinOps und datengetriebene Kostenoptimierung.
- Du überzeugst durch analytisches Denken, den sicheren Umgang mit Kosten-, Verbrauchs- und Performance-Daten sowie durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1-Niveau).
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.
Bewirb dich noch heute!

Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.
Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1733194
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.
With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.
Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Value Creation practice helps PE firms, their portfolio companies, and corporate companies realize better returns by unlocking value and accelerating time to money through targeted operational improvements. We rapidly define, quantify, and help realize significant incremental and sustainable value through revenue enhancement, cost and margin improvement and working capital reduction.
Our Media Value Creation team works with investors and executives across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization to identify, quantify, and realize value creation opportunities.
We help clients unlock value through commercial excellence, go-to-market transformation, revenue growth, pricing and monetization optimization, audience and customer expansion, operating model improvements, and transaction-related value creation initiatives. Our teams work across the transaction lifecycle and beyond, supporting management teams as they execute strategies designed to drive measurable EBITDA growth, accelerate revenue performance, and create long-term enterprise value.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate-Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution Value Creation practice, you will be a vital member of the team executing operational focused projects. You will work on projects that span the entire lifecycle of a transaction, including operational and commercial due diligence where we focus on EBITDA upside and operational risk; buy side carve out and integration planning to ensure a newly spun out business can stand alone and a merger quickly realize and grow anticipated synergies; post-acquisition 100 day and value creation planning; ongoing performance improvement; and exit readiness planning to inform an optimal strategy for maximizing returns and ensuring the buyer is well positioned to continue to enhance value.
You will also contribute to commercial value creation initiatives for Media investors and management teams across subscription, advertising, sponsorship, ticketing, content monetization, rights and licensing, distribution, and audience engagement revenue streams.
Skills and attributes for success
- Media Industry Knowledge – interest in Media and an understanding of relevant business models, value drivers, growth opportunities, and competitive dynamics across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization.
- Project Management – be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the Strategy and Transactions sub service lines.
- Business and Commercially Driven – working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
- Business Development – assist in aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
- Learning – learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.
- Building Relationships – strong working relationships with senior clients, including influence, advice and support to key decision makers.
- The expectation for this role is in person teaming, at client site or in an EY office, a minimum of 60% of the time or on average 3 days a week over the course of an engagement, project or performance year.
To qualify for the role, you must have
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Marketing, Media Studies, Communications, Sports Management, or Entertainment Management and 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
- Strategy and operations management consulting experience.
- Excellent analytical, problem solving/modeling skills, and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.
- Experience in operational or commercial due diligence, operational restructuring, value creation, and performance improvement.
- Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.
- Experience supporting value creation, commercial transformation, go-to-market, revenue growth, pricing, monetization, or performance improvement initiatives.
- Understanding of financial statements and operational performance metrics, including the relationship between commercial initiatives, EBITDA improvement, and enterprise value.
- Experience working in complex business environments.
- The ability to prioritize effectively on projects and the skills to adapt quickly to new challenges and concepts.
- Excellent communication and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.
- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
- Experience working with, advising, or conducting strategic or commercial analysis of one or more of the following Media sub-sectors: Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, Audience Monetization, or related Media sectors.
- Understanding of Media business models and value drivers, including subscription, advertising, sponsorship, content monetization, ticketing, rights and licensing, audience engagement, and distribution economics.
- Experience conducting analyses related to audience acquisition, customer retention, pricing, advertising, sponsorship, subscription growth, content commercialization, rights and licensing, ticketing, or distribution.
- Experience supporting go-to-market strategy, revenue operations, sales effectiveness, marketing effectiveness, pricing, customer acquisition, or commercial operating model initiatives.
- Experience evaluating and quantifying value creation opportunities through transaction-related, commercial transformation, or performance improvement initiatives.
- An understanding of how Media companies create and monetize intellectual property, audiences, rights, content, experiences, and distribution channels.
- Experience translating industry trends, changing consumer behaviors, and evolving monetization models into strategic, commercial, or operational implications.
- A proven record of excellence in a transactions, strategy, commercial, or analytical role.
- Experience gained within a Media company, investment organization, corporate strategy function, or large professional services organization.
- MBA or other relevant graduate degree is preferred.
- Dynamic individuals who thrive in ambiguous situations to help clients solve their most critical strategic, business, and economic challenges.
- Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and commercial problem-solving capabilities with a genuine interest in Media industry growth drivers. They are energized by evaluating opportunities, developing data-driven insights, and helping investors and management teams accelerate commercial performance, improve profitability, and create measurable enterprise value.
If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and a genuine passion for helping Media businesses navigate complex strategic, commercial, and operational challenges, this role is for you
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $130,000 to $205,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Consulting - Senior Consultant – Sales Incentive Management:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
The Senior Consultant - Sales Incentive Management will support the design and delivery of sales incentive and compensation transformation initiatives. This role combines data analysis, solution design, and implementation support. You will work with stakeholders to assess existing compensation plans, identify gaps, and implement incentive frameworks aligned with business objectives. Additionally, you will contribute to building scalable assets and supporting practice growth initiatives.
Your Key Responsibilities
Client Engagement & Delivery
- Support sales incentive transformation engagements from assessment through implementation.
- Analyse current-state compensation structures, incentive plans, quotas, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
- Assist in designing sales incentive plans aligned to business goals, sales roles, and performance drivers.
- Develop models to simulate plan performance, payout curves, and cost implications under different scenarios.
- Support implementation of incentive management processes, governance frameworks, and reporting mechanisms.
- Assist in the configuration or deployment of incentive compensation management tools where applicable.
- Prepare documentation including incentive plan rules, process flows, and calculation logic for implementation and audit purposes.
- Ensure accuracy and quality of deliverables across project workstreams.
Technology & Analytics
- Leverage analytics to evaluate plan effectiveness, sales performance, and ROI on incentive spend.
- Support use of automation and tools for incentive calculation, reporting, and performance tracking.
Business Development Support
- Support proposal development, RFP responses, and creation of client-ready materials related to sales effectiveness and incentive management.
- Contribute to development of reusable models, accelerators, and thought leadership assets
- Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution
- Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also
Have experience or exposure to incentive compensation tools and platforms, quota setting, territory design, sales performance management, and CRM and sales analytics solutions
What we look for
- 5+ years of experience in sales operations, incentive compensation, sales analytics, or consulting.
- Experience in designing or analysing incentive plans and sales compensation structures.
- Strong analytical skills with experience in financial modelling and data analysis.
- Ability to translate business requirements into incentive design and implementation logic.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

The opportunity
EY‑Parthenon advises corporate, government and private equity clients across the full strategy and transaction lifecycle — from corporate and growth strategy, and new market entry, through strategic analysis, deal execution, transaction integration and post‑deal value creation. Our purpose is to create lasting value for clients, people and society by bringing together strategy, transaction expertise and transformation.
As a Senior Consultant, you will join EY-Parthenon’s Financial Services Strategy team, one of the fastest-growing and highest-performing strategy teams in Australia. Based in Sydney or Melbourne, you will work on high-impact strategy engagements for C-suite and senior business leaders across banking, capital markets, asset management, wealth management and insurance.
In this role, you will work on the strategic questions that matter most to financial services leaders, such as helping superannuation funds assess merger options, evaluating acquisition opportunities, designing new customer propositions, improving productivity, and modelling market dynamics to inform growth decisions. You will be part of an ambitious and expanding global strategy practice, working alongside a highly talented team and supported by experienced EY professionals who are committed to helping you thrive and build a strong consulting career at EY-Parthenon.
Representative projects include:
- Supporting a superannuation fund CEO and Board assess potential merger partners, including market-wide analysis of fund cash flows, member demographics and long-term financial sustainability
- Advising on a buyside assessment of a wealth management asset, including testing strategic fit, identifying value creation levers and validating the opportunity through qualitative and quantitative analysis.
- Designing a digital health and wellness proposition for a private health insurer and major retailer, combining insurance products, health services and digital channels to create a more integrated customer experience
This hybrid position is based in Warrang – Sydney.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant in the EY-Parthenon Financial Services Strategy team, you will:
- Serve as a key member on client engagement teams, supporting the team in advising clients on complex strategy issues across the financial services sector
- Contribute to the development of hypotheses and analyses, translating client needs into structured project tasks and high-quality, client-ready outputs
- Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g. market and competitor research, customer and product assessments, and strategic and financial analysis) to identify risks, opportunities, and strategic implications
- Support the development of high-impact reports and presentations, synthesising findings into practical recommendations
Skills and attributes for success
- A bachelor’s degree with outstanding academic performance and at least 3 years of relevant work experience
- Experience developing or supporting corporate strategy in Financial Services (banking, capital markets, payments, insurance, wealth management and/or asset management), gained via consulting and/or industry roles
- Advanced problem-solving skills, curiosity and creative thinking
- Demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis, with the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience in delivering high-quality reports and presentations
- Strong interest in AI and technological change, with demonstrated ability to use generative AI tools effectively in a professional context
- Adept at building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and clients
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Our Climate Change and Sustainability Service (CCaSS) team seeks to build a better working world by helping businesses and governments respond to societal, environmental and economic challenges. We help businesses understand and evaluate the broader value impacts and outcomes associated with their organizations, operations, programs and projects. Our global team is multidisciplinary and combines our core knowledge in accounting and reporting with knowledge in technical and regulatory sustainability issues.
We provide ESG related advisory services to financial market participants, large corporate clients and state owned enterprises too.
Our teams help clients identify their ESG Strategies and action plans, execute impacts with purpose, and continuously improve and report on their sustainability performance. Specifically, we help clients manage emerging risks such as climate risk, reduce costs through design and implementation of systems and processes, and leverage opportunities in areas such as sustainable finance, climate change, circular economy or the European sustainability policies both within their organization and within their supply chains and customer base.
Your key responsibilities
- Collaborate with the other Senior Consultants and Managers to execute EY’s ESG strategy that satisfies high client expectations, support the planning, execution and delivery of the engagements
- Possess the ability to communicate clearly at all levels of the organization about complex issues; and also be able to review the work and act as a mentor of junior colleagues
- Contribute actively in the CCaSS engagement team to understand and respond to the client's needs and expectations and develop a client-focused, clear, accurate and well-presented offerings, proposals and work product
- Ensure work is delivered in a timely manner and in compliance with EY’s high standard requirements
- Work with other service lines and subject matter experts in providing an integrated service delivery across functions in an international team to meet the client expectations of a professionally managed EY network.
- Help to identify and communicate relevant industry trends, regulatory and market developments and key performance drivers towards clients.
- Assist in identifying and developing new opportunities related to new CCaSS projects and business relationships.

Proactive, accountable and results driven people will flourish in this environment. Dealing with competing priorities, understanding how to manage your own resources and communicating effectively are key skills. - Min. 2-3 years of relevant experience in ESG, sustainability, environment or climate change in any profession, but preferably with a consulting mindset

- You have interest in ESG, climate change and sustainability related areas or topics.
- You have strong technical, quantitative and analytical skills.
- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hungarian.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1719594
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Join our Financial Services Office (FSO) and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global market perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including asset management and private equity, banking and capital markets, and insurance, we provide integrated assurance, consulting, strategy & transactions, and tax services to our clients. As a market segment of the FSO, the BBC includes the Bahamas, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, and Cayman Islands. By joining the BBC, you will receive unmatched exposure and experience to our continuously growing portfolio of diverse FSO clients.
Our Strategy & Transactions (SaT) team works with clients to manage their capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increased returns. As part of a global team of 10,000 professionals in 100 countries you will advise clients on preserving, optimizing, raising or investing capital. Major groups (or, as we call them, sub-service lines and competencies) within SaT include Mergers and Acquisition Services, Project Finance, Turnaround & Restructuring, Operational Transaction Services, Transaction Support, Transaction Tax, and Valuations, Economics and Modeling.
The opportunity
Our continued success in the BBC region has propelled rapid growth in our team. We have ambitious plans and we are seeking high-performing seniors to join our Turnaround & Restructuring services team to help in further developing our practice. This role will primarily focus on insolvency and restructuring; the successful candidates should have liquidations experience (both solvent and insolvent), while some restructuring and investigations/forensics experience would be beneficial but is not required for this role. This position is based in Bermuda and, where necessary to meet client demands, in the wider region.
Your key responsibilities
- Working under the supervision of and support the manager, senior manager, director and/or associate partner/partner, execute restructuring, liquidation and/or insolvency procedures as required and contribute to defining the engagement scope
- Actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships and make sure that delivered client work is of high quality; as part of this, you'll anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues, as appropriate
- Prepare analysis and reports supporting the engagement as required to be delivered to clients and other parties and contribute to presenting our work and its findings to the client
- Work effectively as a team member sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
- Demonstrate professionalism and confidence to deal with a range of stakeholder groups and management teams
- Undertake tasks critical for effective onboarding of new clients
- Undertake day-to-day tasks for ongoing engagements to help ensure engagements are progressed effectively and within the allocated budget
- Build strong internal relationships within SaT and across other services
Skills and attributes for success
- Advanced written and verbal communication skills. The ability to produce clear, concise, well-written reports is key to our business
- Knowledge of business trends, relevant legislation, emerging technical and industry developments
- Excellent organizational and project management skills
- Able to multi-task and deadline-driven
- A proactive approach to progressing matters effectively and efficiently and raising key matters with the case manager as required
- An awareness of the importance of recording time accurately and the impact this has on engagement economics
- Ability to work a flexible schedule and you will be expected to work additional hours as required
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Possess or be actively pursuing an internationally recognized professional accounting certification, such as an ACA, CA, CPA or equivalent, or a service line relevant certification, such as a recognized insolvency qualification
- A minimum of three (3) years of recent relevant experience in a similar position, specifically with experience of restructuring and common law liquidations either within the “Big 4” or a boutique restructuring/insolvency firm; successful candidate must have demonstrated leadership and business development skills
- Display a high level of commercial acumen, and an awareness of the key industry drivers
- Proficiency in detailed financial and commercial analysis and able to identify potential areas of sensitivity
- The ability to identify key issues on assignments and suggest workable solutions and experience in presenting findings clearly in reports and other deliverables to clients
Ideally, you may also have
- Appreciation of the risks inherent in advising distressed businesses and their stakeholders
- Knowledge of current market issues in financial services
- Experience working on project-based teams solving complex issues
What we look for
We’re most interested in well-rounded people who are naturally curious and ready to work on engagements from a wide range of backgrounds. In return, you can expect the support of great colleagues, as well the industry-recognized training you’ll need to grow in your career. If you’re a fast learner with great organizational skills, this role is for you.
What we offer
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental and vision coverage, competitive pension plan, generous vacation and leave entitlement(s), and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1743491
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
The financial services landscape is undergoing profound change. Banks and insurers are navigating heightened market volatility, rising cost of risk, evolving client expectations, competition from Tech and Fintech players, and an ever more demanding regulatory agenda — from Basel IV/CRR3-CRD6 and IFRS 9 to ECB supervisory priorities, IRB model reform, ESG and climate risk, and BCBS 239 data governance. In this environment, risk and credit are no longer just control functions — they are strategic levers for growth, capital efficiency and resilience.
At EY, we go further than simply helping our clients cope with these changes: we are part of the change, and we help shape the financial sector of the future. That is why we have built a strong Business Transformation competence team in Belgium, within which our Risk & Credits Transformation experts partner with financial institutions to modernize their credit and risk value chains — from origination and underwriting to monitoring, provisioning, remediation and reporting. Our goal is to help institutions turn regulatory pressure and risk complexity into competitive advantage, by co-creating pragmatic solutions, redesigning credit processes end-to-end, and delivering data-driven, technology-enabled risk assets.
Unlock the door to an exciting career with our Business Transformation team! We're looking for professionals brimming with enthusiasm to elevate their careers to new heights. Whether you're a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Project/Program Manager, or a Risk/Credit specialist, your expertise will be pivotal in steering transformative risk and credit strategies within the financial sector.
Key Responsibilities
Joining our Risk & Credits Transformation team means working shoulder-to-shoulder with clients to reshape their credit and risk operating models, translate complex regulatory requirements into workable business solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in risk management, capital and cost of risk. You'll play a pivotal role in growing our competence team and contributing to the broader success of EY.
As a Risk & Credits Transformation Consultant, your responsibilities will include:
- Designing and optimizing the end-to-end credit lifecycle across banking segments (Retail, SME, Corporate, Real Estate) — including origination, credit decisioning and underwriting, loan servicing, monitoring, early-warning, collections and workout.
- Supporting clients in interpreting and implementing regulatory and prudential change — e.g. Basel IV / CRR3-CRD6, IFRS 9 impairment, IRB model landscape, ECB / NBB expectations, loss data (LossDB) and RDARR / BCBS 239 requirements.
- Redesigning credit risk processes, policies and controls, embedding efficiency, automation and a strong risk-and-control mindset.
- Bridging business, risk and data: framing requirements for rating and provisioning models, credit data quality, risk reporting and management information.
- Ensuring the client's risk and business perspective stays central to the delivery of digital and data-driven solutions in the market.
- Participating in or managing projects and programs from inception to completion — including scoping, planning, budgeting, stakeholder management and team staffing (particularly at Manager level).
- For Manager profiles: leading workstreams and client relationships, coaching junior colleagues, and contributing to business development, proposals and thought leadership.
- Sharing your domain-specific knowledge and expertise to enhance our collective capabilities.
This is an opportunity to join a team that is not only responding to the transformation of risk and credit in financial services, but is actively leading it. If you're passionate about leveraging your experience to help shape the future of finance, we invite you to explore a career with EY Belgium's Business Transformation team.
Skills and Attributes for Success
- Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Finance, Commercial/Civil Engineering, Business, Mathematics or equivalent).
- Professional experience (typically 2 – 5 years for Consultant), in consulting and/or the financial sector, ideally in credit risk, risk management, or credit/lending transformation.
- Familiarity with one or more of the following is a strong asset: credit risk frameworks, IRB / rating models, IFRS 9, Basel / CRR-CRD, credit processes and lending products, risk data & reporting (BCBS 239 / RDARR), or regulatory remediation programs.
- An excellent knowledge of business English, and a solid level of French and/or Dutch.
- Strong team spirit, balanced by a healthy sense of autonomy.
- Excellent analytical skills, conceptual thinking and a pragmatic, delivery-oriented approach.
- Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both business and risk stakeholders up to senior management (Manager level: proven stakeholder and team leadership).
- Certifications such as Agile, Scrum, PMP/Prince2, FRM, PRM or CFA are a differentiator for more experienced candidates.
- Knowledge of lending banking products and processes (e.g. Consumer Loans, Mortgages, Corporate & SME lending, Public Sector lending, Leasing, Factoring) is a major asset.
What working at EY offers
- You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
- You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible.
- You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
- You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
- We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
- While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY es una firma global líder que ofrece servicios de Auditoría, Consultoría, Estrategia y Transacciones e Impuestos, con una red integrada de alrededor de 400.000 profesionales en 150 países del mundo.
Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.
EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.
Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad y buscamos alentar a que se postulen para nuestras diferentes posiciones. En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o apoyo, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.
Acerca del área
Desde Business Transformation para la industria de servicios financieros buscamos incorporar un/a Consultor/a Senior PMO para acompañar programas de transformación de negocio, digital y tecnológica en clientes líderes de Banking, FinTech, Payments e Insurance.
Te proponemos sumarte a una organización global líder en consultoría profesional participando en proyectos de alto impacto junto a equipos multidisciplinarios, con acceso a metodologías globales, herramientas innovadoras y tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo Inteligencia Artificial.
Trabajarás en iniciativas estratégicas orientadas a transformar negocios, optimizar operaciones y acelerar capacidades organizacionales, colaborando con líderes de la industria en programas complejos de cambio y evolución empresarial.
Dentro de nuestro equipo podrás:
- Participar en programas de transformación digital y tecnológica para clientes líderes del mercado.
- Colaborar en proyectos regionales e internacionales con exposición a diferentes mercados e industrias.
- Acceder a metodologías globales, frameworks de gestión, herramientas innovadoras y tecnologías emergentes.
- Integrarte a un entorno de trabajo basado en colaboración, diversidad, inclusión y aprendizaje continuo.
EY trabaja con clientes líderes en toda la región, ayudándolos a resolver algunos de sus desafíos más complejos. Este es el momento ideal para incorporarte a un equipo en continuo crecimiento y dejar tu huella en la transformación de la industria de servicios financieros.
Responsabilidades
- Liderar proyectos y programas estratégicos de transformación para clientes de la industria financiera, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de negocio, alcance, presupuesto y cronograma.
- Gestionar portfolios y oficinas de gestión de proyectos (PMO), coordinando dependencias, riesgos, iniciativas y recursos para garantizar una ejecución efectiva.
- Desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con clientes y stakeholders ejecutivos, actuando como referente en la coordinación y seguimiento de iniciativas estratégicas.
- Impulsar la adopción de metodologías ágiles y mejores prácticas de delivery, promoviendo la mejora continua y la eficiencia operativa.
- Monitorear indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs), realizar seguimiento de avances y asegurar el cumplimiento de hitos y entregables.
- Identificar riesgos, dependencias y desvíos potenciales, definiendo e implementando planes de mitigación adecuados.
- Coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios y facilitar la gestión del cambio necesaria para asegurar la adopción de las iniciativas implementadas.
Requisitos
- Formación de grado en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.
- Posgrado, especialización o MBA será un plus.
- Dominio de idioma inglés verbal y escrito.
- Experiencia mínima de 2 años en empresas de consultoría, tecnología, servicios profesionales o grandes organizaciones con programas de transformación.
- Experiencia previa gestionando proyectos para clientes externos.
- Sólidos conocimientos en gestión de portfolios, Project Management y PMO.
- Experiencia en metodologías de gestión de proyectos y transformación organizacional.
- Se valorará experiencia previa en consultoras globales o empresas multinacionales.
- Perfil orientado a resultados, con capacidad analítica, planificación, organización y excelente manejo de relaciones interpersonales.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con clientes, equipos de trabajo y stakeholders ejecutivos.
¿Qué ofrecemos?
- Formar parte de una de las organizaciones de servicios profesionales más reconocidas a nivel global.
- Participar en programas de transformación digital y tecnológica de alto impacto.
- Exposición a proyectos regionales e internacionales.
- Acceso a metodologías globales, tecnologías emergentes e iniciativas vinculadas a Inteligencia Artificial.
- Formar parte de un equipo altamente reconocido en el mercado y basado en las mejores prácticas.
- Modalidad de trabajo #híbrido.
- Programas de capacitación continua y desarrollo profesional.
- Plataforma de entrenamiento virtual con más de 18.000 cursos disponibles, incluyendo contenidos de Udemy.
- Acceso a EY Badges, programa global de certificaciones en diferentes áreas de conocimiento.
- EY Tech MBA, EY Masters in Business Analytics y EY Masters in Sustainability, desarrollados junto a Hult International Business School.
- Capacitación en idioma inglés mediante clases, webinars y plataformas de aprendizaje.
- Oportunidades de movilidad internacional.
- Cobertura médica privada para vos y tu grupo familiar.
- Consultorios médicos y nutricionales. Programas anuales de salud.
- Políticas de flexibilidad, licencias especiales y programas de acompañamiento familiar.
- Descuentos en importante red de gimnasios, comercios y universidades.
- Revisiones salariales periódicas.
- Beneficios y descuentos en aplicaciones de delivery.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Join our Business Transformation team at EY, where we are looking for Analysts / Senior Consultants to strengthen our Invest practice.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of Private Banking, Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) and regulatory topics (e.g., MiFID).
You will bring strong business expertise to support our clients in adapting their investment offering, ensuring regulatory compliance, and improving client-centric investment journeys.
This role is designed for professionals with a strong content background, rather than a pure consulting profile.
Your key responsibilities
- Investment expertise:
Bring deep understanding of investment products, advisory processes, and client portfolio management within Private Banking / WAM
- Regulatory advisory (MiFID):
Contribute to the design and implementation of regulatory-compliant investment processes (e.g., suitability, investor protection, reporting)
- Process improvement:
Analyze and optimize front-to-back investment processes (advisory, execution, reporting)
- Client engagement:
Work closely with business stakeholders (advisors, product teams, compliance) to translate regulatory and business needs into practical solutions
- Transformation support:
Support transformation initiatives impacting investment activities (digital advisory, product governance, client experience)
- Workshops & deliverables:
Contribute to workshops, business analysis, and high-quality client deliverables
Skills and attributes for success
- Experience (critical):
Background in Private Bank, Asset Manager, or Wealth Manager
(roles such as investment advisor, portfolio manager, product specialist, compliance officer, etc.)
- Regulatory knowledge:
Solid understanding of MiFID and investment-related regulations
- Content over consulting:
Strong functional expertise is more important than prior consulting experience
- Analytical mindset:
Ability to structure complex investment / regulatory topics into clear, actionable insights
- Stakeholder management:
Strong communication skills and ability to interact with front-office and compliance teams
- Languages:
Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good command of English
- Mindset:
Hands-on, pragmatic, and client-oriented, with team spirit and autonomy
What working at EY offers
- You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
- You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible.
- You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
- You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
- We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
- While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
