jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1734664
Location: New York City, Charlotte, Boston, Chicago, Philadelphia
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Consultant within EY's Financial Services Subledger practice, you will help leading insurance, banking, asset management, and alternative investment organizations transform their finance, accounting, reporting, and data environments. You will work with clients to deliver large-scale finance transformation initiatives, investment accounting platform implementations, subledger modernization programs, data migrations, and enterprise reporting solutions.
You'll have the opportunity to work alongside business, accounting, operations, and technology stakeholders to solve complex challenges, improve financial processes, and implement scalable technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency, data quality, and financial reporting capabilities.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Support finance transformation and technology-enabled accounting initiatives
- Deliver investment accounting, subledger, and financial systems implementation programs across the financial services sector.
- Evaluate current-state processes and technologies, design future-state operating models, and support implementation roadmaps.
- Partner with business, accounting, and technology stakeholders to drive solution design and delivery.
Define accounting, reporting, and data requirements
- Gather and document business, functional, data, and reporting requirements.
- Support the design of accounting frameworks, including financial product lifecycles, accounting events, chart of accounts structures, accounting elections, and posting rules.
- Develop functional specifications and process documentation to support business and technology transformation initiatives.
Lead data conversion, reconciliation, and testing activities
- Support data migration, conversion, validation, and reconciliation efforts across complex financial systems.
- Develop and execute testing strategies, test cases, and validation procedures, including functional, integration, user acceptance, and parallel testing.
- Analyze accounting and operational data to investigate issues, resolve discrepancies, and improve data quality.
Develop reporting, analytics, and business intelligence solutions
- Establish a Finance Data Mart that centralizes finance data for downstream reporting and analytics
- Analyze client’s current state reporting processes to document business requirements and technical specifications
- Design and develop financial, regulatory, management, and operational reports and dashboards using business intelligence and data visualization tools to inform decisions and support regulatory compliance
Support solution deployment and business adoption
- Collaborate with software vendors and client stakeholders to support system configuration and implementation.
- Deliver end-user training and support post-go-live stabilization activities.
- Provide ongoing recommendations to improve processes, controls, and reporting effectiveness.
Skills and Attributes for Success
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
- Ability to bridge business and technology teams by translating requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
- Strong communication skills with experience presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
- Demonstrated attention to detail, particularly in data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
- Effective collaboration and relationship-building skills across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
- Strong organizational skills with experience managing deliverables across multiple workstreams.
- A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for leveraging technology, automation, and analytics to solve business challenges.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive solutions in complex transformation environments.
- Commitment to delivering exceptional client service and building trusted relationships.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Experience supporting finance transformation, investment accounting, subledger, financial systems implementation, or technology consulting engagements.
- Experience and understanding of financial products including payments, deposits, loans, securities, debt, derivatives, insurance contracts, reinsurance, etc.
- Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL, Excel, and/or other data analysis tools to solve complex business and accounting challenges.
- Understanding of financial services’ business processes, accounting operations, financial reporting, and data flows.
- Experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders in a client-facing environment.
- Experience analyzing, reconciling, and validating financial and accounting data across system implementations, conversions, or transformation programs.
OR
- Experience defining business, accounting, data, and reporting requirements and translating them into technology-enabled solutions.
- Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25%-50%
Ideally, You'll Also Have
- Experience with investment accounting and financial platforms such as BlackRock Aladdin, Eagle, Clearwater Analytics, SimCorp Dimension, or similar solutions.
- Experience supporting ABOR, IBOR, subledger, general ledger, or investment data mart transformation initiatives.
- Experience within insurance, asset management, banking, wealth management, capital markets, or alternative investment organizations.
- Experience supporting GAAP, STAT, regulatory, management, or audited financial reporting processes.
- Experience designing data models, reporting frameworks, accounting rules, chart of accounts structures, or data integration solutions.
- Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting technologies.
- Experience with data and automation tools including Alteryx, Python, VBA, Power Automate, or related technologies
- Experience leveraging AI enabled tools to improve workflows and processes, conduct analyses, and develop and distribute communications
- Experience with cloud-based transformation initiatives involving AWS, Azure, or modern enterprise data platforms.
- Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
- Experience supporting system testing activities, including user acceptance testing (UAT), system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, or parallel testing.
- Professional certifications such as CPA, CFA, FRM, PMP, or equivalent credentials.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $97,300 to $178,300. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $116,700 to $202,600. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Requisition ID:

Business Transformation Senior Consultant

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.
Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:
-
Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
-
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
-
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
-
Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
-
Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
-
Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi? Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un Business Transformation Senior Consultant in ambito Road&Transportation in EY!
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
- Supportare nell’analisi e nel ridisegno di processi, procedure e definizione di modelli organizzativi e operativi dei clienti;
- Effettuare attività di benchmark e analisi di mercato su operatori di mercato nazionali e internazionali;
- Supportare nel processo di ideazione e sviluppo di use cases su servizi innovativi, dalla fase concettuale fino all'implementazione;
- Eseguire analisi e design di nuovi KPI di business e di processo;
- Effettuare attività di analisi dati per monitoraggio delle performance ed identificazione di tendenze/opportunità
- Svolgere attività di PMO, pianificazione e governance di progetti, definendo report e presentazioni di SAL operativi e direzionali
- Guidare i consulenti junior, favorendo un ambiente collaborativo e orientato alla crescita
Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia:
- Esperienza 2-3 anni in primarie società di consulenza o in società operanti nel settore delle infrastrutture, trasporti, logistica, multiutilities;
- Aver preso parte in progetti di PMO, digital transformation, business process design;
- Utilizzo di programmi come Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point, Power BI per la creazione di report e dashboard dinamiche e interattive;
- Ottime capacità di comunicazione e relazione interpersonale;
- Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale, in modo collaborativo, virtuale e indipendente;
- Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e con scadenze ravvicinate, gestendo le priorità in modo efficace;
- Ottima conoscenza di italiano e inglese.
In EY potrai:
- Accelerare le tue competenze: Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI
- Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali
- Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
- accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
- partecipare a programmi di leadership.
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 32.000€ e 44.000, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione.
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia.
Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
We are looking for proactive and dynamic candidates with experience in finance management who are eager to specialize further in financial consulting and develop innovative solutions to address even the most complex client challenges.
Our team brings together talented professionals with experience in optimizing and digitizing complex financial processes. By joining us, you will have a unique opportunity to work closely with Chief Financial Officers, Treasury leaders, and Finance Managers, helping them transform and digitalize their internal processes and increase productivity across their organizations.
As a Senior Consultant, you will work on complex transformation projects, helping clients optimize and digitalize financial processes while bridging business needs with modern technology solutions. You will have the opportunity to contribute your own ideas, coordinate selected project workstreams, and support the professional growth of both clients and less experienced colleagues.
Your key responsibilities
-
• Participate in exciting projects focused on optimizing and digitalizing financial processes, leveraging your professional knowledge and experience.
• Implement modern technology solutions across finance, controlling, and treasury functions, helping clients establish more efficient and effective processes.
• Coordinate collaboration between clients and internal teams while ensuring the successful delivery of project objectives.

Skills and attributes for success
-
• Minimum 3-4 years of experience in finance, controlling, auditing, or process consulting
• Experience with process mapping, analysis, and optimization of internal processes
• Strong communication skills, a dynamic personality, and a proactive approach
• Experience in project coordination and project management
• Strong logical reasoning and analytical thinking skills
• Willingness to learn and continuously develop new skills

• Fluent Slovak and English language skills
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; knowledge of Power BI or other analytical technologies is considered an advantage

Bonuses and rewards: We value your individual performance and reward you for your achievements.

Requisition ID:
1722031
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
EY-Parthenon supports companies in making investments for organic or acquisitive growth and improvements. This includes strategy development, operational transformations, restructurings, and guiding IPOs, mergers, and acquisitions. By combining the broad knowledge and experience within our team with analytical tools and techniques, and working closely with the global EY-Parthenon network, we help clients make well-informed decisions. We then assist organizations in turning strategy, transactions, or transformations into reality. Our team culture is built on training, entrepreneurship, and creative freedom.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a senior consultant, you’ll be part of the EY-Parthenon Strategy & Execution team, with a focus on People Strategy. Your focus is on advising and supporting clients throughout the entire deal life cycle, providing a range of People and HR-related services on both the sell-side and buy-side. We contribute to and validate the deal price pre-deal and assist in realizing deal synergies post-deal.
You will contribute to the following activities:
- Complex HR due diligence, day-one readiness, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and post-deal value creation such as strategic workforce planning, organization design, employee relations planning and execution, and culture, communication &change initiatives.
- Supporting clients in planning and implementing People and HR elements for organizational restructuring programs at both strategic and operational levels.
- Addressing People and HR-related matters through all stages of acquisition, divestiture, and merger, including pre- and post-deal.
- Writing and reviewing reports, project planning, data analysis, and developing presentation materials. Additionally, analyzing (financial) data and presenting high-quality, risk-managed reports, including client and executive presentations.
- Structuring and managing (international) projects that meet and exceed client expectations, while confidently and effectively recognizing and managing potential issues during client assignments.
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
The People Strategy and M&A team works with clients to manage their employee capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increase returns on investments. As part of a global team of professionals in 100 countries, you will advise clients on preserving, optimizing, raising, or investing capital.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
A background in Finance is not required, but affinity with this discipline and familiarity with financial terminology is important. We invite recent graduates with a Master’s degree from a Dutch university in: Strategy, Business Administration, Finance, Organizational Studies, Econometrics, HRM, or similar to apply.
- Experience in advising clients on a range of transactions and restructurings, ideally in People topics, is a plus.
- In addition to your studies, you have developed yourself in various ways, such as through a relevant internship, a board year, or other extracurricular activities.
- You have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and are highly proficient in both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
- You have a strong and demonstrable affinity with People and HR topics, strategy development, and mergers & acquisitions in a broad sense.
- You are highly experienced with Microsoft Office and Excel. If required, you already hold a valid work permit.
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
- You’ll receive a contract for 40 hours.
- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
- 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.
- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
1. For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
2. Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.
3. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.
4. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.
5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

Requisition ID:
1725936
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
Are you passionate about sustainability and thrive in solving challenging tasks that directly contribute to a better environment and society? Do you enjoy working with financial sector in supporting their sustainability ambitions and challenges? Join our growing Climate Change and Sustainability Services Team as part of a wider Assurance Advisory team within EY!
The world is facing one of the biggest challenges of humankind – constant changing of climate under today’s way we conduct economic activities. Climate change is no longer a distant sustainability concern but an immediate and systemic risk. Increasingly severe physical impacts (such as extreme weather events, resource scarcity, and infrastructure damage) combined with accelerating regulatory and market transitions are forcing governments and companies to fundamentally adapt their strategies, moving away from business-as-usual models.
When the financial services industry works well, it creates growth, prosperity, and peace of mind for hundreds of millions of people. No other industry touches so many lives or shapes so many futures. At EY Financial Services, we share a single focus — to build a better financial services industry, not just for now, but for the future.
Sustainability is at the heart of our EY brand. It is at the heart of our strategy, what we value and measure and what we do every day with our clients and within our own business. We are proud to be advocates of change to make businesses across the world more sustainable because we believe in long-term value. Delivering sustainable long-term value in Financial Services means new strategies, a new approach to managing risks, new products and services and new ways of engaging stakeholders.
Opportunity
We are looking for a high performing Consultant to join our Climate Change and Sustainable Services team dedicated to Financial Services. You will join a rapidly growing team of climate change and sustainability practitioners globally, with your base in Zurich, Switzerland, embracing a unique opportunity to make a real difference. You will be working on market leading projects, building networks, and consulting on key strategic issues in sustainable finance.
There is a wide range of exciting projects that you will be able to get involved in, across banking, insurance, pensions, wealth and asset management and private equity. You will work with clients at all levels to deliver first-class services helping them navigate the rapidly evolving sustainability agenda. Topics we cover include:
- Sustainable Finance regulatory developments and requirements by the financial sector from the EU regulatory side (such as CSRD, EU Taxonomy and SFDR) and Swiss regulatory side (such as RBI, FINMA requirements and AMAS, SBA, SIA self-regulations);
- Reporting and disclosure, including the application of ESRS, ISSB, TCFD, GRI, TNFD and other frameworks;
- Sustainable finance and net zero strategies, such as transition plans, for financial services;
- Climate change metrics and targets, greenhouse gas reporting, including the SBTi, Greenhouse Gas Protocol and PCAF;
- Responsible, sustainable and impact investment strategies and implementation;
What We Look For
- You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, motivated, committed, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
- You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers.
- You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Delivery of projects to our clients on a wide range of sustainability topics we work on, such as Regulation implementation, Sustainability Reporting & Assurance engagements for our clients from financial services organizations.
- Create innovative commercial insights for clients, adapt methods and practices to fit operational team and cultural contexts, and contribute to thought leadership.
- Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects and internal initiatives, consistently driving projects to completion making sure that the work delivered is industry leading.
- Working closely with colleagues, create a positive learning culture.
- Contribute to the development of EY capabilities in technical areas and engage with clients regarding the application of these methodologies to their businesses.
- Collaborate with colleagues outside of CCaSS to deliver multi-disciplinary and cross-geographical work.
Skills And Attributes For Success
As Consultant within the team, you will be exposed to a range of assurance and advisory work in direct exchange with the clients. It is therefore essential that you bring the competencies that will allowing you to do so:
- High motivation and shared values for sustainability, social matters, governance-related topics and finance;
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills;
- Familiarity with AI topics and tools (e.g., data analytics, generative AI) and the ability to leverage them in a consulting context;
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written;
- Strong interpersonal skills;
- Ability to manage multiple deliverables in parallel projects;
- Ability to work effectively in team-oriented, multi-cultural environment.
Qualifications
We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds, but are particularly interested in individuals that have the following qualifications:
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, economics, environmental sciences or related fields of study;
- Internship or experiences within ESG, sustainable finance environment or climate risk, ideally focusing on advisory/consulting, assurance in financial institutions or in consulting firms;
- Ideally experience in projects in the field of non-financial information and/or integrated reporting, assurance of non-financial, ESG data (as ESG specialist / Investor Relation department, controlling, financial reporting etc) or as an external consultant. Good knowledge of SDGs, GHG-accounting, PCAF, carbon foot printing or Life Cycle Analysis is a plus
- A keen interest in, and understanding of ESG as it relates to financial services (banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, and/or private equity)
- Interest in and understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and their application to sustainability, reporting, and financial services transformation
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a pragmatic approach to problem solving, dynamic working style, well organized and structured
- A demonstrated capacity to take initiative, overcome challenges and work collaboratively through relevant work or project experience;
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, French is a plus
What’s In It For You
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need to stay relevant today and, in the future, – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. - Maintain robust process documentation, SOPs, desktop procedures, control evidence and knowledge repositories.
- Identify financial and operational risks early, implement preventive and corrective actions, and support internal, statutory and external audits.
- Promote a strong controls and compliance culture while balancing governance with efficient business outcomes. Transformation & Operational Excellence
- Drive simplification, standardization, automation and productivity improvement across the assigned portfolio.
- Use data and process insights to identify recurring issues, remove non-value-added activities and improve customer experience.
- Partner with technology, process owners and business teams on system implementations, migrations, transitions and continuous-improvement programs.
- Embed scalable ways of working and share leading practices across teams and locations. Stakeholder & Change Management
- Build trusted relationships with business finance, operations, procurement, sales, tax, legal, technology, banks, vendors, customers and auditors, as relevant to the portfolio.
- Facilitate governance reviews, resolve escalations, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure ownership of agreed actions.
- Act as a change leader during organizational, process and technology transformation. People Leadership

title: Financial Services - Data Center Transformation - Technology Consulting -  Senior - NYC
summary: Requisition ID: 1750969 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
education: Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, construction management, architecture, business or related discipline.
jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750969
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
The business problems our clients are facing today are not the same problems they have faced in the past. The rapid pace of development in Artificial Intelligence and the technology that enables it has created an urgent need to innovate and adapt to the new global business paradigm. Financial institutions are looking to build smarter and more efficient ways to operate their business, create new revenue streams, and better manage risk, through new opportunities uncovered by their data. We believe that to fully unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence, we need to look not only at its application, but also at the strategy level for how best to transform the enterprise into one that is technology and data focused and ready for the new age. Our clients’ problems are becoming increasingly complex while at the same time the need to automate and streamline is rising.
The opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Consultant who can support the analysis and day-to-day delivery required to move a financial institution from data center strategy (including co-lo) and Cloud into executable decisions and plans. This is not a general project coordinator role. The candidate should have hands-on exposure to at least one substantive part of the data center lifecycle and enough range to work across critical facilities, IT infrastructure, migration, resiliency and third-party providers.
The work is focused primarily on banking, capital markets, insurance and payments clients. Selected assignments may include other highly regulated or mission-critical organizations where resilience, control, and disciplined execution are central to the client's agenda.
Your key responsibilities
-
Perform current-state assessments of data center and Cloud hosted environments using client data, interviews, site information and technical documents; convert findings into capacity, risk, dependency and decision views.
-
Support colocation and provider evaluations by developing requirements, scoring criteria, RFP content, evaluation workbooks, site-visit materials and executive comparisons.
-
Analyze readiness across space, power, cooling, connectivity, compute, storage, network, backup and operational support.
-
Support build and migration planning through integrated schedules, RAID management, dependency analysis, readiness checkpoints, test evidence, runbooks and go/no-go materials.
-
Develop application and infrastructure inventories, validate data quality, trace dependencies, and identify gaps that could affect migration sequencing or service continuity.
-
Prepare client-ready Excel models, PowerPoint decision materials, process and architecture diagrams, status reports, and executive summaries.
-
Facilitate working sessions across facilities, infrastructure, applications, network, cyber, resiliency, sourcing, finance, risk and providers.
-
Own assigned work products and escalate issues with a fact base and recommended path forward.
Required experience and qualifications
-
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, construction management, architecture, business or related discipline.
-
At least 3 years of relevant experience in data centers or Cloud , IT infrastructure, critical facilities, hybrid infrastructure, infrastructure transformation, resiliency or capital-program delivery.
-
Experience producing real delivery artifacts such as requirements, inventories, dependency maps, schedules, RAID logs, evaluation workbooks, readiness evidence, runbooks or executive reporting.
-
Experience working across multiple technical and business stakeholder groups, not only within a single support or administration team.
-
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in business and risk terms.
-
Public-cloud migration experience is relevant and is a substitute for data center infrastructure migration, consolidation and exit experience although experience with both is preferred
Required software and analytical tooling
-
Advanced Microsoft Excel, including structured analysis, lookups, pivot tables, quality checks, and management reporting.
-
Strong Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to create concise, executive-ready storyline and decision materials.
-
Working capability in Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart or equivalent for process, dependency, architecture or facility diagrams.
-
Practical use of Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira or Azure DevOps to manage milestones, dependencies, risks and actions.
-
Experience extracting, reconciling or analyzing information from at least one infrastructure source such as a DCIM platform, ServiceNow CMDB/ITSM, BMC Helix, Device42, BMS/EPMS, VMware vCenter or cloud inventory tooling. Expertise in every platform is not required.
AI-enabled delivery
-
Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot or comparable enterprise generative AI tools to improve research, analysis, requirements development, data review, documentation, reporting or workflow automation is preferred.
-
Candidates should be able to explain how they validated AI-generated outputs, protected confidential information, and applied professional judgment before using the work product.
Preferred experience
-
Financial services infrastructure, operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, or third-party risk.
-
Exposure to MEP and critical systems, including electrical distribution, UPS/generators, cooling, controls, and telecommunications.
-
Colocation sourcing, workload migration, data center consolidation or facility modernization.
-
Relevant credentials such as PMP, ITIL, Uptime Institute, engineering, or commissioning credentials are preferred but not required.
Skills and attributes for success
-
Ability to work through complex facility, infrastructure, and operational information and turn it into practical analysis and clear client decisions.
-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, dependencies and gaps that may affect delivery.
-
Clear written and verbal communication across technical, operational, and business audiences.
-
Ability to work effectively across client teams, EY workstreams and third-party providers while maintaining focus on quality and follow-through.
-
Curiosity and willingness to build capability across adjacent areas of the data center lifecycle.
-
A practical ownership mindset and interest in producing work that clients can use to make and execute decisions.
What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
-
- New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $134,700 to $202,200
- Bay Area California offices – $140,400 to $210,700

At EY, we are all in to shape your future with confidence. We will help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
We are looking for seasoned strategy professionals to join our rapidly growing Corporate Strategy Consulting team in the MENA at Associate and Senior levels. As part of EY Parthenon Strategy, you will have the opportunity to deliver projects that make a strong impact onthe region and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning.
Your key responsibilities
In this role within the strategy consulting practice, you will be a key participant in work streams and engagements as you translate client needs into project tasks and deliverables. You will work closely with clients to define the objective and scope of the engagements and deliverables in consultation with your seniors. You can expect to spend most of your time working on strategy-related projects which includes long-term strategy roadmaps, growth strategy, market entry & expansion strategy, go-to-market strategy, business-wide digital transformation projects, commercial due diligence, and greenfield projects.
Your clients may include global corporates, governments and public entities, family conglomerates, and sovereign wealth funds. The EY-Parthenon Strategy team typically works directly with C-Suite executives on their strategicand transaction decisions.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams in Düsseldorf, Köln, Frankfurt/Main, München, Hannover, Hamburg, Berlin oder Stuttgart berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei der Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen in den Bereichen Rechnungswesen und Logistik. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von digitalen Transformationsprojekten mit Schwerpunkt auf Accounting-, Beschaffungs- und Logistikprozesse (u.a. im Umfeld von SAP S/4HANA)
- Beratung unserer Kund:innen mit Schwerpunkt auf Purchase-To-Pay (P2P) Prozesse – von der Strategieentwicklung über die Konzepterstellung bis zur Implementierung
- Entwicklung von Konzepten zur Optimierung der Einkaufs- und Zahlungsprozesse, einschließlich der Definition von Steuerungsmodellen und KPI-Modellen
- Strategieentwicklung für den Einsatz neuster Technologien (KI, Cloud, etc.) zur Automatisierung der Prozesse
- Unterstützung bei der Akquisition von Projekten und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios im Bereich P2P
Dein Skillset
- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie je nach Einstiegslevel 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder in einem großen Unternehmen mit Fokus auf Accounting/Rechnungslegung (HGB/IFRS), Beschaffung und Logistik
- Interesse an Finanzprozessen, Digitalisierung sowie aktuellen Themen im Finance-Umfeld (z.B. Sustainable Finance, KI, E-Rechnung) und fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA sowie Erfahrung in der Implementierung von S/4HANA-Transformationen, insbesondere in den Modulen FI, MM, SD und WM
- Hohe Technologieaffinität, Begeisterung für die Arbeit in einem agilen Projektumfeld und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Hohe Flexibilität, sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft (auch für internationale Herausforderungen)
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - FINANCE - Chennai
TMT :
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
CNS - BC - FINANCE :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
- Role Profile JOB TITLE Supervisor – Procure to Pay JOB SUMMARY The role supervises end-to-end PTP delivery across invoice processing, payments, vendor queries, reconciliations and exception resolution. The role leads the team, monitors service performance and maintains effective controls. The role also analyses AP reports, including ageing reports, payment forecasts and KPIs, to identify trends and support management decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Team Leadership and Management:
- Supervise, mentor, and train a team of PTP Specialists.
- Delegate tasks effectively and monitor team performance against established goals and KPIs.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
- Foster a positive and collaborative team environment.
- Address and resolve employee issues and concerns promptly and effectively.
- Ensure adequate staffing levels and manage team schedules. 2. PTP Process Oversight:
- Oversee the entire PTP process, from purchase requisition to payment disbursement.
- Ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices, T&E claims, purchase orders, and payment requests.
- Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy within the PTP cycle.
- Monitor and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, purchase orders, and payments.
- Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., Purchasing, Receiving, Finance) to ensure smooth PTP operations. 3. Compliance and Controls:
- Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
- Maintain and enforce internal controls to safeguard company assets and prevent fraud.
- Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.
- Stay up-to-date on changes in accounting regulations and best practices. 4. Reporting and Analysis:
- Analyze accounts payable reports, including aging reports, payment forecasts, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Identify trends and anomalies in accounts payable data and recommend corrective actions.
- Provide timely and accurate information to management as requested. 5. Problem Solving and Issue Resolution:
- Serve as a point of escalation for complex accounts payable issues.
- Investigate and resolve discrepancies, errors, and other problems in a timely and efficient manner.
- Develop and implement solutions to prevent recurring issues.
- Reviewing and approving vendor statement reconciliations and ensuring timely resolution of outstanding items. 6. System Management:
- Work with IT and other departments to maintain and improve the accounts payable system.
- Participate in system upgrades and implementations.

Requisition ID:
1694210
What if your next role wasn't about who you are today-but who you could become?
At EY, we don't just offer jobs-we help you build futures. Join a globally connected, diverse and inclusive organization where technology, innovation, and high performing teams come together to help you thrive.
We're looking for talented graduates and early career professionals to join our Finance Transformation team, part of our Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) practice within Assurance.
Role Overview
EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies.
The role is suited for individuals who understand the challenges faced by CFOs and Finance teams, and who are passionate about using technology to improve finance processes, enhance decision-making, reduce manual effort, and create more agile, insight-driven Finance functions.
The successful candidate will work on transformation projects covering areas such as finance process improvement, reporting and analytics, automation, digital finance tools, data management, AI-enabled use cases, performance management, and operating model redesign.
Key Responsibilities
As a Consultant, you will support the delivery of Finance Transformation projects by combining finance understanding with strong analytical, technology and problem-solving skills. Your responsibilities will include:
- Assist in analysing current-state finance processes, systems, reports, data and pain points.
- Support the identification of improvement opportunities across finance operations, reporting, analytics, automation and controls.
- Help translate Finance function challenges into practical technology-enabled solutions.
- Support the development of dashboards, reports, analytical models, automation workflows and process documentation.
- Use tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Automate, VBA and GenAI tools to support project work.
- Assist in preparing client presentations, workshop materials, process maps, data analysis outputs, business requirements and transformation recommendations.
- Support Finance Transformation diagnostics, benchmarking, opportunity assessments and roadmap development.
- Work closely with senior team members and client stakeholders to gather information, analyse findings and develop practical recommendations.
- Contribute to internal knowledge development around AI, automation, analytics and digital finance use cases.
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong interest and practical capability in data, analytics, automation and digital finance, including:
- Strong experience or hands-on exposure to ETL tools, Python, Power BI, SQL and data management tools.
- Fundamental understanding of Generative AI tools and their practical applications.
- Ability to demonstrate how GenAI has been used, or can be used, in current work, academic projects or previous roles.
- Exposure to Python / PySpark, AI/ML concepts and advanced analytics will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
- Experience with automation tools such as VBA, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

Technical Excellence

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Process PO and non-PO invoices, credit notes, and other transactions accurately within agreed timelines, including GL account and cost-centre assignment and provisions for future payments.

- Working on rejected invoices from approver.
- Process vendor payment runs in line with payment schedules, approval requirements, and internal controls.
- Investigating supplier queries and providing solutions.
- Process and reconcile travel and expense claims and resolve related discrepancies.
- Monitoring aging documents and taking correct actions to meet the TAT.
- Reporting: EOD reporting on Recording and invoice completion.
- Assisting in month end closing.
- Review and achieve daily and monthly target.
- Perform vendor statement reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and identify root causes of variances.
- Preparing AP Trial Balance, reconciliations and investigating variances.
- Generating and sharing remittance advice to vendors.
- Maintaining and archiving invoices and supporting documents as per document retention policies. ROLE-SPECIFIC SKILLS/ATTRIBUTES Skills/Experience
- B. Com graduate with 2-4 years of experience in PTP.

- Excellent interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in ERP platforms, along with advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting skills. Signed: ………………………………………………………………… Signed: …………………………………………………... (Employee) (Manager)

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1694205
Shape the Future of Finance. Build Confidence. Drive Transformation.
At EY, we don’t just respond to change — we shape it.
Within Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS), we help organisations reimagine their finance functions through data, technology, and innovation. As finance leaders face increasing complexity, our teams work at the intersection of accounting, analytics, automation, and emerging technology to deliver future ready solutions.
We are now seeking a Finance Transformation Senior Consultant to play a leading role in delivering high impact transformation initiatives for local and global clients.
Role Overview
EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies.
The role is suited for individuals who understand the challenges faced by CFOs and Finance teams, and who are passionate about using technology to improve finance processes, enhance decision-making, reduce manual effort, and create more agile, insight-driven Finance functions.
The successful candidate will work on transformation projects covering areas such as finance process improvement, reporting and analytics, automation, digital finance tools, data management, AI-enabled use cases, performance management, and operating model redesign.
Key Duties
As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to take a leading delivery role across finance transformation engagements. Your responsibilities will include:
- Support the design and delivery of Finance Transformation projects for clients across different industries.
- Analyse current-state finance processes, systems, reports, data flows and pain points.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, controls, reporting quality and decision-making.
- Translate CFO and Finance function challenges into practical digital, automation, analytics and AI-enabled use cases.
- Work with client teams to define business requirements, process improvements, data requirements and solution concepts.
- Develop dashboards, data models, automation workflows, analytical tools, prototypes and proof-of-concepts where required.
- Use tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, Power Automate, UiPath, VBA and GenAI solutions to support project delivery.
- Contribute to project planning, workstream management, stakeholder discussions, documentation and client presentations.
- Support proposal development, diagnostic assessments, business case preparation and transformation roadmaps.
- Guide junior team members and contribute to building internal capability in AI, automation and data-driven finance transformation.
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong technical and analytical capability, including:
- Strong experience with ETL tools, Python, Power BI, SQL and data management tools.
- Good understanding of Finance data structures, reporting requirements and data quality considerations.
- Fundamental understanding of Generative AI tools and their practical applications in business or finance contexts.
- Ability to demonstrate how GenAI is being used, or can be used, in current or previous work to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, reporting or decision-making.
- Exposure to Python / PySpark, AI/ML concepts, advanced analytics and data modelling.
- Experience with automation tools such as VBA, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate will be a strong advantage.
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to convert analysis into clear, professional client-ready outputs.
- Ability to build or support prototypes, analytical models, dashboards or automation solutions to solve business problems.
Awareness of emerging technologies relevant to the Finance function, such as AI, machine learning, automation, blockchain, fintech and cloud-based finance platforms
Professional Experience
- Minimum 4 years of experience in finance transformation, consulting, advisory, analytics, automation, data, digital transformation or related roles.
- Experience working on business projects where technology, data or automation played a central role.
- Proven track record of delivering finance transformation, reporting, analytics, automation or technology-enabled improvement projects.
- Strong understanding of current CFO challenges, including cost pressure, faster reporting, better forecasting, process efficiency, finance talent constraints, data quality, governance and the need for real-time insights.
- Experience working with Finance functions such as Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, statutory reporting or performance management.
- Ability to work with both Finance and Technology stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to manage workstreams, coordinate tasks, guide junior team members and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, STEM, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field.
- Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CFA, CIMA or equivalent will be an advantage.
- Additional certifications in Power BI, data analytics, automation, AI, cloud platforms, project management or finance transformation will be considered positively.

Standort:
Berlin
Anderer Ort:
Bundesweit

wettbewerbsfähig

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams in Düsseldorf, Köln, Frankfurt/Main, München, Hannover, Hamburg, Berlin oder Stuttgart berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei der Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen im Rechnungswesen und Controlling. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von digitalen Transformationsprojekten mit Schwerpunkt auf Accounting- und Controlling-Prozessen (u.a. im Umfeld von SAP S/4HANA) – von der Strategieentwicklung über die Konzepterstellung bis zur Implementierung
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Prozessen mit Schwerpunkt entweder im Financial Accounting (FI) oder im Controlling – etwa in der Ergebnis- und Margenrechnung (CO-PA, Margin Analysis) sowie im Produktkostencontrolling (CO-PC)
- Ausgestaltung des Rechnungswesens je nach Schwerpunkt: im Financial Accounting (FI) von Hauptbuch über Anlagen- bis zur Nebenbuchhaltung oder im Controlling von der Kosten- und Deckungsbeitragsrechnung bis zur Produktkostenkalkulation – inkl. Integration in die angrenzenden Prozesse (MM, SD)
- Strategieentwicklung für den Einsatz neuster Technologien (AI, Cloud, etc.) zur Automatisierung der Prozesse im Finance-Umfeld
- Verantwortung für Projektfortschritte und fachliche Führung von Teammitgliedern
Dein Skillset
- Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld (in der Beratung oder in einem großen Unternehmen) mit Fokus auf Accounting- und Controlling-Prozessen
- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar. Klarer Schwerpunkt im Umfeld von SAP S/4HANA entweder im Financial Accounting (FI) oder im Controlling mit fundierten Kenntnissen in mindestens einem Bereich – Ergebnisrechnung (CO-PA, Margin Analysis) oder Produktkostencontrolling (CO-PC)
- Interesse an Finanzprozessen, Digitalisierung und aktuellen Themen im Finance-Umfeld (z.B. Sustainable Finance, AI). Hohe Flexibilität, sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie Reisebereitschaft (auch für internationale Herausforderungen). Technologieaffinität, Begeisterung für die Arbeit in einem agilen Projektumfeld und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.
Bewirb dich noch heute!
Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.
Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.
Du hast noch Fragen? Unser Recruitment Center beantwortet diese gerne unter +49 6196 996 10005.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Consultant-National-PAS WKFA-CNS-PC-Talent - Bangalore
National :
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
CNS-PC-Talent :
At EY, People Consulting professionals help clients' in strategically aligning their people agenda with broader business goals. By placing Humans@Center of the transformation journey, we help organizations drive sustainable change through the power of their workforce. Our approach enables clients to reimagine their future workforce—ensuring they have the right talent, with the right skills, in the right roles, at the right cost—ultimately turning their people strategy into a competitive advantage.
The key fields of play are:
Organization and Workforce Transformation- Integrated approach to align business and workforce strategies with current and future operating models by applying capabilities such as scenario modelling, org design, workforce planning & analytics as well as talent strategy, leveraging our proprietary, award-winning EY Organization & Talent Hub.
Change Experience & Learning - Working with clients to define the new Workforce Experience including New Ways of Working (Agile, Design Thinking, Digital, Problem Solving, Collaboration) as well as accelerated adoption through our digitally-enabled Change Experience tracked via Change Insights and Digital Learning via our EY Noggin Labs platform.
Purpose, Culture and Leadership - Align leadership and cultural programs with clients’ business strategy, purpose and operating model, adapting to the changing needs of their customers and building modern leadership and talent capabilities to drive efficiency and innovation.
HR Transformation, Systems and Rewards - Re-imagining and digitizing the HR function, including HR strategy, HR service delivery model, HR cloud technology as well as transforming employee policies and rewards to align with business and individual objectives.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
- Strong consulting capability in Talent Management, Organization Design, and Learning solutions. Ability to analyze workforce and organizational needs and translate them into structured PAS WKFA recommendations. Experience supporting HR transformation and talent-related process design within consulting engagements. Proficient in assessing current-state talent processes and developing improved future-state operating models. Skilled in applying general consulting methods to deliver data-driven, client-focused talent and organization solutions.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
- PG Diploma in Human Resource Management
Experience
- TALENT MANAGEMENT
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
