Senior Business Consultant - Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation
Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.
The opportunity
EY GDS is a global leader in delivering value-added Digital Supply Chain and Operations Transformation services to clients across industries. As organizations continue to rethink their supply chains to improve resilience, efficiency and customer service, there is a growing demand for professionals who can combine logistics domain expertise with strong consulting capabilities.
As a Senior Business Consultant, you will work with clients to assess, redesign and optimize logistics and supply chain operations. You will support strategic and operational initiatives across transportation, warehousing, inventory management, distribution networks and end-to-end supply chain processes, helping organizations improve performance and drive sustainable business value.
This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programs, operational assessments, strategy engagements and process improvement initiatives while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across geographies and industries.
Your key responsibilities
- Conduct logistics and supply chain assessments to identify operational inefficiencies, improvement opportunities and value creation potential
- Analyze current-state business processes and design future-state operating models across transportation, warehousing and inventory management functions
- Lead workshops, interviews and stakeholder discussions to gather business requirements and define transformation roadmaps
- Support clients in developing supply chain and logistics strategies aligned with business objectives and growth plans
- Evaluate logistics operating models, organizational structures and governance frameworks.
- Perform supply chain diagnostics and benchmarking exercises using industry leading practices and performance indicators
- Analyze logistics networks, transportation operations and warehouse processes to identify optimization opportunities
- Develop business cases and value assessments for transformation initiatives.
- Prepare executive presentations, reports and recommendations for senior client stakeholders
- Support business development activities, proposals, client pursuits and thought leadership initiatives
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams supporting supply chain, operations, technology and transformation programs
- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies and leading practices in logistics and supply chain management
Skills and attributes for success
- Strong understanding of logistics and supply chain processes, including transportation, warehousing, inventory management and distribution operations
- Ability to analyze complex business challenges and develop practical, value-driven recommendations
- Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder interviews and business process assessments
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities supported by quantitative and qualitative analysis skills
- Ability to structure and communicate insights effectively to business and executive stakeholders
- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in client-facing environments.
- Self-driven, collaborative and client-focused mindset with a passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field
- 5+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain consulting, operations transformation or process improvement initiatives
- Experience conducting business assessments, operational reviews, maturity assessments or strategic transformation projects
- Strong knowledge of supply chain and logistics operating models and industry leading practices
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior leadership teams.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and presentation development capabilities
- Experience developing recommendations, business cases and transformation roadmaps based on quantitative and qualitative findings
Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience in Manufacturing, Retail, Consumer Products, Automotive, Life Sciences or Distribution industries
- Exposure to transportation management, warehouse management, inventory optimization or supply chain planning processes
- Experience supporting business development activities, client pursuits and proposal preparation
- Knowledge of supply chain network design, logistics optimization and performance management methodologies
- Exposure to digital transformation and emerging supply chain technologies.
- Experience working in international and multicultural project environments
- Professional certifications related to Supply Chain, Logistics, Lean, Six Sigma or Project Management
What we look for
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand client challenges and transform them into actionable recommendations
- Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to continuously learn new business concepts, methodologies and industry practices
- Adaptability and willingness to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced and evolving client environments
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities
- Proactive, results-oriented and solution-focused approach to problem solving
- Ability to work effectively within diverse and geographically distributed teams
- Strong collaboration, communication and knowledge-sharing skills
- Passion for delivering measurable business outcomes and operational excellence
- Excellent oral and written communication skills. Professional proficiency in English is mandatory, while knowledge of additional languages will be considered a valuable asset
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across ten locations – Argentina, China, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning:You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Database Architecture & Design

- Deep knowledge of performance tuning, index optimization, and query execution plans.
- Proven experience with HA/DR solutions, replication topologies, and failover strategies.
- Strong command of Linux administration (RHEL/Ubuntu).
- Excellent scripting in Shell, Python, or Bash.
- Knowledge of security practices, SSL/TLS, IAM, roles/privileges, and encryption mechanisms.

Requisition ID:
1750042
Location: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, San Francisco
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.
With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.
Your key responsibilities
Consultants participate as valued members of case teams helping clients address their most pressing strategic challenges. Consultants identify information sources, assemble data, perform analyses, structure arguments and develop presentations. Training is given in key business concepts and analytical methods immediately upon joining the firm and throughout their EY-Parthenon career. Consultants are able to gain responsibility quickly, often serving as primary contacts for clients and managing junior case team members.
Our teams work on a variety of complex and strategic client issues at the C-suite. The range of assignments includes developing long-term strategies for organizations, evaluating the potential acquisition of businesses, improving educational achievement outcomes, developing new marketing channel strategies, reducing operating costs, and evaluating new business ventures.
Skills and attributes for success
- Perform secondary research using a variety of sources (e.g., analyst reports, market research reports, news articles).
- Executing various analyses (e.g., customer segmentation, market sizing, competitor analysis, macroeconomic forecasting) to support the strategic recommendations.
- Designing and executing in-depth interview guides with key organizational stakeholders, industry experts and customers.
- Analyzing business plans and pro-forma financial models to help identify key assumptions and drivers.
- Maintaining relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels and other internal teams on the engagement.
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Outstanding academic performance, with a bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
- Experience in strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, market research, or similar role performing leveraging quantitative research for health industry clients.
- Ability to conduct detailed analysis on products, markets, competitors and customers to identify risks and opportunities across the health industry.
- Proficient in the English language, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment.
- Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
- Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
- Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills.
- Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We are interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients' goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.
What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $130,000 to $200,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

- EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750174
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals!
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams
Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world.
The opportunity
In consulting, change is the only constant, and we like it that way. Our clients face constant disruption from AI and automation, shifting regulations and rising customer expectations. They count on us to turn that complexity into an advantage.
As a Business Transformation Consultant, you'll join the local market leader in Consulting and work in diverse, high-performing teams on projects for major organizations in Greece and abroad. You'll help clients rethink how work gets done: redesigning processes end to end, building operating models that last and putting AI agents, automation and data to work where they create real value.
From your first project, you'll learn by doing, with real responsibility, coaching from experienced practitioners and the backing of a global network. You'll also help shape where our business goes next. If you want to build a career that makes a measurable difference, this is where it starts.
Your key responsibilities
In this high-visibility role as a Business Transformation Consultant, you will participate in challenging global, regional and local projects and are expected to:
- Uncover the real problem: Take part in client workshops and interviews. Gather information, understand pain points and find improvement opportunities, spotting the real root causes behind the obvious symptoms.
- Map, measure and redesign: Analyze, improve and document end-to-end business processes and operating models, using data, best-practice frameworks and structured problem-solving. Measure performance with KPIs and data. Design leaner, more automated and better-controlled ways of working.
- Harness technology: Help assess where AI, automation, process mining and analytics can remove waste and friction, improve decisions, strengthen control and create measurable value.
- Create and deliver: Turn analysis into clear, high-quality deliverables such as process maps, assessments, target operating models, business cases, roadmaps and executive presentations.
- Grow the business: Contribute to business development, including proposals, market research, thought leadership and new service offerings to help us stay ahead of what clients will need next.
- Build something new: Help evolve our methods, accelerators and toolkits as we grow.
- Invest in yourself: Maintain a continuous desire to learn, build your professional toolkit through formal training, certifications and on-the-job coaching, and share what you learn with your team.
To qualify for the role you must have
- A university degree in engineering, business, economics, finance, mathematics, physics, computer science or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and comfort working with numbers, data and ambiguity
- Practical experience using generative AI tools to work smarter (e.g., Microsoft Copilot)
- Ability to build clear analyses and communicate them visually
- Excellent written and verbal communication in Greek and English
- Willingness to travel and work abroad when projects require it
Ideally, you’ll also
While not required, any of the following will be regarded positively:
- A Master's degree or MBA, particularly in operations, management, engineering, business, analytics, computer science or a related field
- Internship or early-career experience (up to 2 years) in consulting, professional services or a transformation, operations or process excellence role/ project
- Lean and/or Six Sigma certification (Yellow or Green Belt), or practical exposure to continuous improvement methods
- Familiarity with process modeling and mining, and with relevant tools (e.g. SAP Signavio, ARIS, Celonis, Visio)
- Data and analytics skills, such as Power BI, SQL, Python or low-code and automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate)
- Exposure to Agile ways of working or project management basics (e.g., Scrum, PRINCE2 or CAPM foundation)
- Understanding of how a company's processes connect end to end (e.g., procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report), including awareness of internal controls and risk.
Skills & attributes for success
- Curiosity, ambition and drive: You ask "why?" often, set yourself high goals, stay motivated to grow with every project and you're always learning something new.
- A team player mindset: You do your best work in diverse teams, share knowledge freely and build trust with clients and colleagues.
- Ownership: You take responsibility for your work, meet your commitments and speak up with ideas.
- Execution discipline: You manage your time and competing priorities well and deliver high-quality work at pace.
- Structured thinking with a practical mindset: You bring order to messy problems and focus on what will make a real difference.
- Attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture: You can map a process step by step and still explain why it matters to the CEO.
- Clear communication and storytelling: You communicate with clarity and respect, and turn complex analysis into concise, compelling messages.
- Resilience and adaptability: You handle tight deadlines, changing priorities and setbacks well and you see ambiguity as an opportunity
- Integrity: You act ethically and build trust by doing the right thing.
- Creativity and innovation: You look beyond "how it's always been done," come up with fresh ideas and are willing to test new approaches and technologies.
- Passion for making things better: You’re passionate about achieving excellence and continuous improvement and energized by using technology to create lasting business value.
What we offer you
Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:
- Developing your professional growth:
- You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
- Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.
- Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.
- Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
- Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.
- Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
- Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).
- Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
EY  |  Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Risk Consulting – AI Governance - Senior
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits.
Are you a tech-savvy professional with a risk mindset who is passionate about building a better working world through the power of people, technology, and innovation? We have an incredible opportunity for you to join our dynamic Enterprise Risk team and make a real impact in the rapidly evolving world we live in. Within Risk Consulting, you will focus in the areas of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Risk Management and Governance which would cover AI Auditing techniques, AI Risk and Controls, Pre-Implementation reviews, Data Privacy reviews, AI application security and BCP review of AI Applications.
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies.
Key responsibilities
Your key responsibilities will include:
- Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
- Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
- Use knowledge of the current IT environment, AI models and applications and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
- Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.
Skills and attributes for success
- You will leverage your proven track record of technology plus business process internal audit experience and strong personal skills, to effectively deliver quality results in the assessment, design, and support implementation of AI Risk solutions
To qualify for the role, you must have
- A bachelor’s or master’s degree and approximately 3-6 years of related work experience
- At least 2-4 years of working experience in Internal audit, risk, compliance for both business and IT audits, with a strong understands of AI related risks and governance practices.
- IT Pre-implementation and Post implementation reviews
- Model Risk Management
- AI Compliance and regulatory assessments – Risk and Controls assessment of AI/ML applications in line with AI related regulations and frameworks
- Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify security findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified on applications and infrastructure. Develop risk control matrix in line with EU AI Act, COBIT, ISO, NIST and ITIL Best Practice and recommendations.
- Control Monitoring / Testing - Understanding of Cyber and compliance standards like PCI, ISO27001, perform test the design and operational effectiveness of the cyber controls.
- Defect / Gap Identification: Identify the confidentiality, integrity and the availability related deficiencies in the client environment and evaluate against industry standards.
- IT Infrastructure and Architecture risk assessments including data quality and data migration reviews, data privacy reviews, OS DB reviews etc.
- Control Automation – Identify controls automation opportunities through analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
- Excellent communication, documentation and report writing skills.
- Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
- Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI Ethics and AI Assurance
- Ability to identify process level risk arising from the use of AI and develop mitigation strategies.
- Good to have relevant industry certifications such as AIGP, ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you, we are counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Team and the opportunity

The Finance competency at EY is a multifaceted team that focuses on providing expert guidance and support to clients in navigating complex regulatory landscapes, managing and analysing finance and risk data, and implementing finance transformation initiatives. Our goal is to drive the finance functions’ effectiveness, agility and value contribution within the client’s organisation which can include integration of new technologies, optimisation of processes and the adoption of innovative practices.

- Quick to understand intricate business challenges and devise suitable solutions

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to stakeholders

- Minimum 2-5 years of experience in delivering change in a finance function environment – gained either from prior experience in consulting or through a track record of delivering change/transformation projects in industry (Preferred industry experience include financial services, insurance, data transformation, financial risk management)
- Exceptional analytical and communication skills with a proven ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders
- Proven experience in developing structured presentations using PowerPoint and analytic skills using Excel

At EY, we are continuing to grow our Supply Chain & Operations Consulting practice to meet increasing client demand for digital transformation across Life Sciences manufacturing, laboratory, quality, supply chain, and AI-enabled operations.
Within our Life Sciences Supply Chain Manufacturing Operations & AI Transformation Delivery team, we help pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device organizations modernize laboratory and quality operations, unlock value from digital technologies, improve data quality and governance, and accelerate adoption of next-generation capabilities including AI, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.
In addition to delivering client engagements, you will contribute to the growth of EY's Life Sciences consulting practice through business development, solution development, thought leadership, and team development activities.
As a Senior Consultant in Supply Chain Manufacturing Operations & AI Transformation Delivery, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical-device clients to transform laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain processes through the implementation of modern digital solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Competitive business today is all about making intelligent, informed choices. We are looking for an individual who is passionate about helping our clients to solve their toughest supply chain problems.
As a Senior Consultant in Supply Chain, you will:
- Build valued relationships with client stakeholders and internal EY teams.
- Support proposal development, business development activities, and market growth initiatives.
- Contribute to the development of EY methodologies, accelerators, and Life Sciences transformation offerings.
- Support the development of thought leadership and market insights related to laboratory, quality, and digital transformation.
- Participate in practice-building activities and support the continued growth of EY's Supply Chain & Operations team.
- Assess laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain processes through stakeholder interviews, workshops, site observations, and operational data reviews.
- Partner with laboratory SMEs, quality teams, manufacturing operations, and technology stakeholders to understand current-state processes and identify opportunities for standardization and digital transformation.
- Facilitate business process assessments, requirements workshops, and design sessions to define future-state operating models and system capabilities.
- Develop and maintain process maps, user stories, business requirements, functional specifications, and operational workflows to support digital transformation initiatives.
- Review, update, and support the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and supporting process documentation.
- Translate business and operational requirements into master data, configuration, reporting, analytics, and integration requirements.
- Support the implementation of laboratory and manufacturing systems, including LIMS, MES, quality systems, and associated data platforms.
- Work with solution architects, data teams, and implementation partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and operational requirements.
- Support master data design activities by identifying business rules, data definitions, process dependencies, and governance requirements.
- Develop and execute test scenarios, document defects, support issue resolution, and maintain traceability between requirements and testing outcomes.
- Support deployment readiness, end-user training, hypercare activities, and business adoption efforts.
- Contribute to analytics and AI use cases by assessing process workflows, evaluating data quality, and helping identify opportunities to improve decision-making, efficiency, compliance, and operational performance.
- Communicate project progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to client stakeholders and engagement leadership.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To thrive in this role, you should be comfortable working at the intersection of business operations, process transformation, data, and technology. You will bring:
- Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and communication skills.
- Ability to develop innovative approaches to client challenges.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
- Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and project activities.
- Commercial awareness and the ability to identify growth opportunities.
- Ability to balance operational detail with strategic thinking.
- Business process analysis and requirements gathering expertise.
- Strong understanding of QC laboratory operations and related quality processes.
- Experience documenting current-state and future-state business processes.
- Process mapping and business process design capabilities.
- Knowledge of SOP, Work Instruction, and controlled documentation development.
- Ability to translate business processes into technology, configuration, master data, and reporting requirements.
- Understanding of regulated GxP environments and the importance of documentation, traceability, and data integrity.
- Interest in leveraging analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational effectiveness.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
- A bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in Life Sciences operations, laboratory informatics, quality operations, business process transformation, technology consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or other regulated environments.
- Experience conducting business process analysis and gathering requirements from operational stakeholders.
- Experience documenting business processes, workflows, SOPs, work instructions, or functional requirements.
- Experience collaborating with laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and technology teams to design and implement process improvements.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including workshop facilitation and stakeholder management.
- Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements.
Ideally, You'll Also Have
- Experience with LIMS platforms such as Veeva LIMS, LabWare, LabVantage, or similar laboratory systems.
- Experience supporting laboratory digital transformation, quality transformation, or business process standardization programs.
- Knowledge of master data management concepts and governance frameworks.
- Experience supporting system implementation projects, including configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and adoption activities.
- Familiarity with MES, ERP, QMS, manufacturing data platforms, and integration concepts.
- Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, or data-driven process optimization initiatives.
- Experience working with global and cross-functional teams across multiple regions and time zones.
- Understanding of GxP compliance, computer system validation, electronic records, and data integrity requirements.
- Relevant technology, Agile, quality, laboratory, or project management certifications.
What Working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
Career Progression:
- When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
- Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Client-facing Life Sciences manufacturing professional who helps design, build, test, and deploy digital solutions for regulated plant operations. The role combines practical knowledge of manufacturing processes with hands-on skills in manufacturing systems, industrial data, integration, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.
The Opportunity
As a Senior in Supply Chain Manufacturing, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical-device clients to connect production, quality, laboratory, engineering, and supply chain needs with deployable technology. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycle, from plant and system assessments through requirements, solution design, configuration support, testing, deployment, adoption, and stabilization.
You will work directly with operators, engineers, quality teams, IT and OT specialists, data teams, and technology providers. You will own assigned technical and functional deliverables, help resolve implementation issues, and make clear recommendations to your workstream lead. The role calls for someone who can examine a shop-floor workflow, trace the data and systems behind it, and turn what they learn into a design or testable requirement.
Your key responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Assess manufacturing and quality workflows, user needs, system interfaces, equipment data, and current-state pain points through site observations, interviews, workshops, and data review.
- Document process flows, user stories, functional requirements, data mappings, interface requirements, controls, and acceptance criteria for digital manufacturing solutions.
- Support the design and implementation of capabilities such as manufacturing execution, electronic batch records and electronic device history records (eDHRs), recipe and routing management, batch and unit genealogy, review by exception, connected-worker workflows, and plant performance reporting.
- Trace information across relevant systems, including MES/MOM, ERP, LIMS, QMS, historians, SCADA, DCS/PLC, and asset-management platforms; identify data gaps, inconsistent definitions, and integration dependencies.
- Develop and review equipment and batch hierarchies, source-to-target mappings, data-quality rules, and contextualized datasets with manufacturing, automation, and data specialists.
- Work with solution architects and engineers on interface specifications, APIs, industrial connectivity, and the movement of data between plant, edge, and enterprise environments.
- Configure or prototype solution components where appropriate to your experience and the engagement, and document design decisions for review by technical and client leads.
- Prepare and execute functional and integration test scripts, record defects, support resolution and retesting, and maintain traceability between requirements and test evidence.
- Support deployment readiness, cutover, user training, hypercare, and handover by preparing clear technical documentation and responding to issues from plant users.
- Partner with client quality and validation teams to prepare or review applicable documentation concerning GxP, data integrity, electronic records, change control, and computer system validation or risk-based assurance.
- Contribute to analytics and AI use cases by assessing source-data quality, defining manufacturing context, checking outputs against operational workflows, and documenting where human review is needed.
- Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and recommended next steps to client counterparts and engagement leaders; coordinate defined tasks with junior colleagues when needed.
Skills and attributes for success
To thrive in this role, you should be able to work in depth in at least one technical area while collaborating across the broader manufacturing solution. You will bring:
- Manufacturing and quality understanding: Knowledge of how production execution, batch records, equipment, materials, laboratory results, deviations, and quality review connect in a regulated plant.
- Manufacturing technology skills: Hands-on functional, configuration, integration, testing, or support experience with one or more manufacturing, quality, laboratory, automation, or industrial-data solutions.
- Data and integration skills: Ability to identify source systems, interpret batch and equipment data, document mappings and interfaces, investigate data-quality issues, and explain how information moves between OT and enterprise systems.
- Delivery discipline: Ability to produce accurate requirements, design documents, test scripts, defect records, and deployment materials, and to follow issues through resolution.
- Technical communication: Ability to discuss an operational problem with a plant user and document it clearly enough for a developer, data engineer, automation specialist, or tester to act on.
- Regulated-delivery awareness: Understanding of why documentation, traceability, controlled changes, and reliable data matter when a solution supports GxP activities.
- Analytical judgment: Curiosity about AI and advanced analytics, paired with the ability to test whether the underlying data, workflow, and proposed output are fit for use.
To qualify for the role, you must have:
- A bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, manufacturing, information systems, computer science, supply chain, or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in Life Sciences manufacturing, manufacturing systems, automation, industrial data, systems implementation, technology consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working with manufacturing or quality processes in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or comparably regulated environment.
- Experience producing technical or functional delivery artifacts, such as requirements, process maps, data mappings, interface specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, or deployment materials.
- Experience collaborating with both operational stakeholders and technical delivery teams to investigate requirements, resolve issues, or implement a solution.
- Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements. Travel can range from 80-100%.
Ideally, you’ll also have:
- Experience with MES/MOM, electronic batch records or eDHRs, recipe management, LIMS, QMS, historians, SCADA, DCS/PLC, connected-worker solutions, or industrial data platforms.
- Experience examining manufacturing data from more than one source and relating it to assets, materials, products, orders, recipes, batches, or quality events.
- Familiarity with ISA-88/IEC 61512 batch concepts, ISA-95/IEC 62264 manufacturing information models, or industrial connectivity approaches such as OPC UA and MQTT/Sparkplug.
- Exposure to GxP computer system validation, risk-based software assurance, data-integrity controls, electronic records, or OT cybersecurity considerations relevant to the system being delivered.
- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and continuous improvement practices, including the use of manufacturing data to monitor process performance, identify variability, and improve quality, throughput, and operational performance.
- Experience supporting analytics or AI use cases in manufacturing or quality, such as process monitoring, predictive maintenance, deviation investigation, or decision support.
- Experience with drug substance, drug product, biologics, sterile manufacturing, medical devices, or technology transfer.
- Relevant platform, cloud, data, automation, Agile, or manufacturing certification.
What we look for
We are looking for a Senior who enjoys getting close to the manufacturing process and the technology that supports it. The strongest candidates ask precise questions, produce dependable technical work, recognize when data or design assumptions do not hold up, and collaborate well with plant, quality, and technology teams to make solutions usable in practice.
What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
The Senior Consultant - CRM and Sales Transformation will support CRM and sales transformation initiatives within the Customer - MSS practice. This role combines CRM process design, sales effectiveness improvement, requirements structuring, delivery support, and stakeholder coordination. You will work with client teams to assess current-state sales and CRM processes, identify improvement opportunities, support solution design, and help implement CRM-enabled workflows that improve pipeline discipline, customer engagement, forecasting quality, and sales productivity.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Business Development & Market Leadership
- Support CRM and sales transformation pursuits by contributing to proposals, RFP responses, client discussion materials, and solution narratives.
- Conduct secondary research, benchmark analysis, and market scan activities to support CRM modernization and sales effectiveness offerings.
- Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, playbooks, and point-of-view materials on CRM adoption, sales process standardization, and digital selling enablement.
- Support preparation of executive presentations, workshop materials, and client-facing deliverables to communicate transformation opportunities and recommendations.
- Keep abreast of CRM platform capabilities, AI-enabled sales insights, sales enablement tools, and evolving customer engagement models that may affect client growth priorities.
- Client Engagement & Delivery
- Support CRM and sales transformation engagements from current-state assessment through design, implementation planning, adoption support, and benefits tracking.
- Assess sales processes, CRM usage, data quality, lead management, opportunity management, account planning, pipeline governance, forecasting, and performance reporting practices.
- Document business requirements, process flows, user stories, functional specifications, operating model components, and adoption considerations for CRM-enabled transformation initiatives.
- Support design of CRM workflows, sales process frameworks, dashboards, governance routines, role definitions, and performance management mechanisms.
- Work with sales, marketing, service, technology, and data teams to translate business priorities into structured delivery inputs and implementation-ready artefacts.
- Support CRM adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, training inputs, change impact documentation, communications support, and adoption tracking.
- Contribute to business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, conversion improvement, forecast accuracy improvement, revenue uplift, and cost-to-sell reduction.
- Track project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and actions to support delivery excellence across scope, timeline, and quality expectations.
- Technology & Innovation
- Support teams in leveraging CRM platforms, workflow automation, sales analytics, sales enablement tools, customer data platforms, and AI-enabled insights to improve sales effectiveness.
- Assist in defining data, reporting, integration, and adoption considerations for CRM-enabled sales transformation initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to use accelerators, templates, analytics, and automation to improve discovery, solution design, requirements readiness, and delivery governance.
- Leadership & People Development
- Coordinate with consultants, analysts, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables and high-quality project execution.
- Support knowledge sharing, team enablement, and coaching of junior team members on CRM transformation methods, requirements documentation, and structured problem solving.
- Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
- Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also
- Demonstrate knowledge of CRM and sales transformation capabilities, including operating model design, adoption strategy, sales governance, territory planning, incentive effectiveness, and pipeline optimization.
- Have experience leveraging AI-driven sales capabilities, including lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, customer 360 insights, and advanced sales performance analytics.
- Have exposure to leading CRM platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Sales Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, HubSpot, Oracle CX, SAP Sales Cloud, and similar technologies.
- Bring experience delivering transformation initiatives across industries such as professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer products, healthcare, financial services, or other B2B sectors.
What we look for
- 5+ years of experience in CRM transformation, sales transformation, commercial excellence, sales operations, customer engagement transformation, or digital transformation.
- Consulting experience is desired
- Experience supporting CRM-enabled transformation programs, sales process improvement initiatives, CRM adoption activities, or sales performance improvement projects.
- Strong understanding of lead management, opportunity management, pipeline governance, account planning, forecasting, customer data, and sales performance metrics.
- Hands-on exposure to CRM platforms, sales analytics, workflow automation, sales enablement tools, or sales process redesign.
- Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and project management skills.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Berater AI Transformation von Finanzprozessen - Business Consulting (w/m/d)
Standort:
Berlin
Anderer Ort:
Bundesweit
Gehalt:
wettbewerbsfähig
Datum:
06.10.2026
Jobbeschreibung
Stellenanzeigen ID:
1633735
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams an den Standorten Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Düsseldorf, Köln, Frankfurt/Main, Stuttgart oder München berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei der Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen im Rechnungswesen und Controlling. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Mitarbeit in Teams von AI-Spezialisten und Finanzfachleuten bei der Entwicklung innovativer Agentic AI-Lösungen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Transformation von Finanzprozessen
- Entwurf und Implementierung von Agentic AI-Lösungen, die die neuesten agentischen Rahmenwerke nutzen, um wesentliche Teile von Finanzprozessen zu automatisieren
- Zusammenarbeit mit Teams von Near- und Offshore-Ressourcen sowie Verwaltung von Projektzeitplänen, Budgets und Ressourcen, um die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung von Lösungen innerhalb der festgelegten Parameter sicherzustellen
- Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, fachkundige Beratung zu bieten und sicherzustellen, dass die strategischen Ziele der Kund:innen eingehalten werden
- Überwachung von Branchentrends und Fortschritten in der AI-Technologie, um die Dienstleistungsangebote kontinuierlich zu verbessern und einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu erhalten
Dein Skillset
- Studienabschluss im Bereich Finanzen, Informatik, Datenwissenschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich sowie je nach Einstiegslevel 2-8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Transformation von Finanzprozessen, der Entwicklung von AI-Lösungen oder verwandten Bereichen
- Starkes Verständnis von AI-Technologien, insbesondere im Kontext von Finanzen, nachweisliche Erfolge in der Führung von Teams und im Management komplexer Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit Prozessumwandlungen im Kontext von GBS und/oder S/4HANA
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch auf C1 Niveau sowie die zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen zu enablen und anzuleiten
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job, helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.
Bewirb dich noch heute!
Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.
Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.
Du hast noch Fragen? Unser Recruitment Center beantwortet diese gerne unter +49 6196 996 10005.

Standort:
Berlin

wettbewerbsfähig
Datum:
06.10.2026

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Dann komm dorthin, wo beides zusammenläuft: Bei EY-Parthenon begleitest du CEOs, Vorstände und Private-Equity-Gesellschaften bei transaktionsbasierten Transformationen vom ersten strategischen Gedanken bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Strategy-Teams in Berlin, Hamburg, Stuttgart, Frankfurt/Main, Düsseldorf oder München entwickelst du Strategien, die Unternehmen nicht nur heute weiterbringen, sondern nachhaltig Wert schaffen. Du durchleuchtest Märkte und verstehst Wettbewerb und Kund:innen bis ins Detail. Ob klassische Beratungsprojekte, große M&A-Deals oder strategische Private-Equity-Vorhaben – du bist dort, wo Unternehmen weitreichende Entscheidungen treffen. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:
- Du berätst nationale und internationale Unternehmenslenker:innen bei der Erstellung von Strategiekonzepten und entwickelst dich zu einem Trusted Advisor auf C-Level.
- Du stellst die Weichen für zukunftsweisende Transformationen und Transaktionen und führst sie gemeinsam mit anderen Teams aus dem EY-Netzwerk zum Erfolg.
- Du unterstützt bei der Durchführung von Commercial Due Diligences zur Bewertung von Chancen und Risiken im Rahmen von Transaktionen.
- Du tauchst in unterschiedliche Branchen ein und lernst vielfältige Projekttypen kennen. So entwickelst du dich zu einem vielseitigen Professional und vereinst fachliche Exzellenz und tiefgreifendes Branchenwissen.
Dein Skillset

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1717664
Senior Consultant - Business Consulting – Finance
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In EY puoi dare forma alla tua carriera e contribuire a costruire un mondo del lavoro migliore, insieme a chi lo sta già trasformando ogni giorno.
Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:
- Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: fin dal primo giorno, eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, disponibili per tutti;
- Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona;
- Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera;
- Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
- Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
- Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi?
Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Senior Consultant - Business Consulting – Finance
In Business Consulting accompagniamo i nostri clienti lungo percorsi trasformativi in un’ottica end-to-end, offrendo valore di lungo termine attraverso le competenze, le soluzioni, gli strumenti e l’innovazione di EY. Aiutiamo a risolvere le sfide complesse delle organizzazioni bancarie che affrontano il cambiamento nell'era digitale, ridisegnando e trasformando strategie e modelli di business, stimolando la crescita, generando l’efficienza, rispondendo ai nuovi needs regolamentari e superando le sfide operative. Nello specifico, il nostro team si occupa di progetti di trasformazione riguardanti principalmente gli ambiti Risk, Regulatory e Lending, con focus sulla gestione end-to-end degli stakeholder (business, IT, fornitori terzi) al fine di garantire la messa a terra delle iniziative nel rispetto delle scadenze progettuali.
Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia:
- Esperienze progettuali maturate presso primari istituti bancari in ambito IT con ruolo di Business Analyst/PMO
- Padronanza degli aspetti legati al mondo dati (nozioni di interfacciamento tra sistemi/motori, servizi online, costituzione basi dati, ETL, tracciati, aggregazione)
- Conoscenze pregresse dei mondi Regulatory e Risk inclusa la conoscenza delle principali metriche in ambito Credit Risk e Crediti
- Laurea in discipline ingegneristiche (gestionale, preferibilmente con esami svolti in ambito bancario e finanziario) o economiche
- Attitudine ad interfacciarsi direttamente con il cliente e dimostrata capacità organizzativa (ad es., raccolta e gestione di dati/evidenze a supporto della preparazione dei deliverables di sintesi)
- Un mindset analitico e spirito di squadra
- Capacità di utilizzo di Excel (la conoscenza del linguaggio SQL / SAS/ SAS Guide / Python costituirebbe un plus)
In EY potrai:
- Accelerare le tue competenze: Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI
- Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali
- Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
- accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
- partecipare a programmi di leadership.
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 34.000€ e 39.000€ definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione.
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in.
Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia.
Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1739813
Requisition id: 1739813
The opportunity : Project Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - Jaipur
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
- Strong capability in project review, tracking, and monitoring to ensure delivery milestones and action items are consistently managed. Proficient in preparing accurate reports and maintaining detailed documentation to support consulting engagements and governance needs. Skilled in research and analytics to synthesize data, identify trends, and support evidence-based recommendations. Able to develop clear client presentations that translate findings into concise, actionable insights. Working knowledge of procurement processes, process improvement methods, and Power BI for enhanced analysis and reporting.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
- Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering
- Bachelor of Commerce
- Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
Experience
- Project Management (6+ years)
- Business Analysis (3+ years)
- Technical Support (2+ years)
- Technical Writing (2+ years)
- Business Intelligence (3+ years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

wettbewerbsfähig

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Business Transformation Teams in Düsseldorf, München, Stuttgart oder Berlin berätst du unsere Kund:innen im Rahmen von komplexen Transformationsprojekten aus unternehmerischer und ganzheitlicher Perspektive mit innovativen Ansätzen. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Planung, Leitung und Unterstützung in innovativen und relevanten Projektstrukturen rund um das Thema Energie- und Wärmewende sowie den Herausforderungen und Chancen der Digitalisierung
- Umfassende Rundumbetreuung von Energieunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer Geschäftsmodelle im Rahmen der Dekarbonisierung
- Mitarbeit in Themen und Projekten mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Relevanz der Transformation zu einer klimaneutralen Energiewelt
- Durchführung von Organisations-, Prozess- und Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen inklusive der Ableitung von konkreten Verbesserungsvorschlägen
Dein Skillset
- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften sowie Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen o.ä.
- Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Energiewirtschaft oder Transformationsprozessen
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf C1‑Niveau, Englischkenntnisse auf B2‑Niveau sowie eine hohe Reisebereitschaft (mind. 50 %)
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Requisition ID:
1542146
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
Join FSO - Technology Consulting, where purposeful growth and cross-functional teamwork are the cornerstones of our success. We partner with clients to navigate complex technological landscapes, providing strategic insights and practical solutions that drive business and technology transformations. We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment that values the best experience for all, with a commitment to career development that ensures that our team members have the opportunities to thrive and excel. Our diverse competencies, including AI & Data, Cyber Security, Technology Strategy and Transformation, and Finance Platforms, collaborate to deliver cutting-edge solutions and drive technological advancements that empower our clients to achieve their goals.
Your key responsibilities
- Understand clients' business needs to align IT strategies effectively.
- Create live demos for relevant use cases and stay informed on emerging technologies (Cloud, Data Analytics, ML & AI, Process Mining, etc.), assess their market impact and relevance to clients' current and future business models.
- Facilitate business transformation by leveraging technology and applying agile and waterfall methodologies.
- Manage technology-driven projects, including resource allocation, activity planning, and work product oversight.
- Assist in IT cost optimization initiatives to enhance financial efficiency.
- Participate in assessment, design, and IT implementation projects, providing vital support.
- Analyze data to derive insights and propose actionable strategies.
- Communicate findings and deliverables clearly to clients and senior team members.
- Work collaboratively in dynamic, cross-functional teams to achieve project goals.
Skills and attributes for success
- A passion for Information Technologies, Digital Innovation and Financial Services
- A degree in Business Information Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration with a strong technology affinity, or equivalent
- Fluency in French and English; German is beneficial
- First working experience in technology consulting or a technology delivery environment in Financial Services (Banking & Capital Markets, Wealth & Asset Management, or Insurance)
- Strong analytical skills with an ability to structure and analyze problems in a systematic and organized way
- The ability to break down and structure complex matters and communicate them effectively to senior stakeholders
- An open-minded motivated personality willing to work in teams
- An entrepreneurial mentality with the willingness to drive and own solutions
- Can-do mindset, with a focus on high performance standards and ability to work in a focused and independent manner
- Coding and prompt engineering capabilities
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
